reviews.name: Morgan Gibbs-White
reviews.pros:
Gets away from midfielders quickly and can turn defence into attack. 

* Doesn't feel like a CAM who is only there to assist; he can genuinely finish chances. 

* Good at finding forwards with quick combinations and clever final balls.
reviews.cons:
3 star weak foot, a noticeable drawback at CAM, especially when receiving or shooting on his weaker side. 

* Stronger midfielders can knock him off the ball. 

* Don't expect him to consistently win the ball back. 

* Aggressive pressing can make him difficult to use centrally. 

* Some games he'll be heavily involved, while others he can fade away.
reviews.verdict: He's exciting when attacking, quick turns, good movement and the ability to create or finish chances make him enjoyable to use. But the 3 star weak foot becomes noticeable in central areas, while his physical and defensive limitations can leave you wanting more. He's a fun card for attacking gameplay, but if you're looking for a CAM who performs consistently from every angle, there are stronger options.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Eden Hazard
reviews.pros:
An explosive LW with incredible pace, especially with the Rapid playstyle. 

* Dribbling feels extremely smooth thanks to his agile body type and excellent ball control. 

* Finesse Expert makes his finishing even more dangerous, and he's very reliable with both feet. 

* Long shots are good, especially with his strong foot. 

* Passing is excellent, with short passes, long balls, and crossing all feeling accurate. 

* Good physicality makes him capable of holding the ball and competing in duels. 

* His 5'9 height works well for his dribbling and movement. 

* Finesse Shot and Playmaker traits add even more quality to his attacking gameplay. 

* Can also play as LM, where he performs brilliantly.
reviews.cons:
4 star weak foot is the only real downside, especially for long-range efforts. 

* At 29K shards, he's good value, but some other top cards are already performing slightly better.
reviews.verdict: A very smooth and explosive winger with excellent pace, dribbling, passing, and finishing. He's a fantastic option for 29K shards, although there are a few stronger alternatives available.

reviews.name: Jamal Musiala
reviews.pros:
Musiala has good pace for the CAM position, allowing him to move quickly through midfield and make dangerous forward runs. 

* His shooting is reliable when using his strong foot, making him a consistent threat around the box and giving him the ability to finish chances rather than relying only on his playmaking. 

* Musiala is very good at contributing to the attack through his passing and chance creation. 

* He feels smooth and responsive while dribbling, and the Level 1 Trickster skill point further improves his ability to take on defenders and create space in tight areas. 

* Having 5-star skill moves is a major advantage, giving him access to a wider variety of skill moves. 

* His physicality is decent for a CAM, helping him handle contact better and maintain possession when challenged by opposing players.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot can be a limitation because his passing and finishing become less reliable when he is forced onto his weaker foot. 

* His stamina is a concern. His effectiveness and movement can drop later in the game if he is constantly involved in attacking plays and dribbling.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Jamal Musiala is a very good attacking midfielder with good pace, strong-foot shooting, playmaking, smooth dribbling, 5-star skill moves, and decent physicality. The Level 1 Trickster skill point makes him even more enjoyable on the ball and helps him beat defenders in tight situations. His 4-star weak foot and stamina are the main drawbacks, but his overall attacking qualities make him a strong option at CAM.

reviews.name: Dennis Bergkamp
reviews.pros:
Bergkamp has good pace for a striker, and the False 9 skill point helps improve his movement and mobility, allowing him to make better runs and keep up with faster defenders. 

* His shooting is one of his biggest strengths. Finesse Expert makes his finesse shots more effective, while Clinical Finisher helps him become more reliable when finishing chances inside and around the box. 

* Bergkamp is not only useful for scoring but can also contribute to build-up play with his passing and ability to create chances for his teammates. 

* He feels smooth and comfortable while dribbling, with the False 9 skill point helping his movement and overall responsiveness on the ball. 

* He has good physicality for a striker, allowing him to hold off defenders better and stay involved in physical battles.
reviews.cons: His 4-star weak foot is the main drawback. While his strong foot finishing is excellent, shots and passes on his weaker foot can be less consistent.
reviews.verdict: Bergkamp is a very well-rounded striker with good pace, excellent shooting, decent playmaking, smooth dribbling, and solid physicality. The False 9 skill point is especially useful for his overall feel and movement, while Finesse Expert and Clinical Finisher make him a dangerous finisher. His 4-star weak foot is the main weakness, but overall, he should still be a very effective ST for players who can work around that limitation.

reviews.name: Ousmane Dembele
reviews.pros:
Great pace burst, feels extremely quick with Rapid Lv.2, especially when attacking open space. 

* 5 star Weak Foot + 5 star Skill Moves is an absolutely crazy combo, letting him finish with either foot and use every skill move effectively. 

* Finesse shots are excellent, with great curve and accuracy thanks to the Finesse Expert PlayStyle. 

* Shooting and finishing are amazing, with top-notch shot power making him a serious threat from different areas. 

* Excellent joystick response, balance and dribbling make him feel agile, smooth and very responsive. 

* Heel to Heel, Step Over, Roulette and Lane Change all work really well. Elastico isn't as good as his UTOTS version, but still feels decent. 

* Has RW and RM as alternate positions, and he's very effective there too. Rapid helps him make dangerous runs into space down the wing. 

* Speed Dribbler, Finesse Shot and Long Shot Taker traits further boost his effectiveness and complement his attacking stats.
reviews.cons:
No major weakness, but there isn't a huge upgrade over his UTOTS version. If you already have UTOTS Dembélé, saving your shards makes sense. 

* If you need the higher OVR, though, this version definitely won't disappoint.
reviews.verdict: Dembélé is an absolute monster up front. The 5 star/5 star combo, elite pace, smooth dribbling and ridiculous finesse shots make him incredibly difficult to defend. Rapid Lv.2 makes his pace burst even more dangerous, while his RW and RM alternate positions give him extra versatility. He isn't a massive upgrade over UTOTS Dembélé, but if you're looking for a higher OVR version, this card is still easily one of the best attackers you can get.

reviews.name: Pele
reviews.pros:
Elite pace for a CAM, he feels really quick on the ball and can easily burst away from defenders. 

* 5 star weak foot + 5 star skill moves is a crazy combo, making him dangerous with either foot and giving you every skill move to work with. 

* Trickster Lvl 2 makes his skill moves feel faster and smoother, while also keeping the ball really close. 

* Shooting is absolutely top-notch. He finishes really well inside the box and can also score comfortably from outside. 

* Clinical Finisher makes his regular shots even more reliable, especially around the box where he feels super clinical. 

* Dribbling is probably one of his biggest strengths. He's agile, smooth on the joystick and has a really nice response when changing direction. 

* Passing feels really good too, making him great for quick link-up play and creating chances around the box. 

* His Finesse Shot, Speed Dribbler and Play Maker traits fit his gameplay perfectly and make him even more dangerous going forward. 

* High attacking work rate and good stamina keep him involved throughout the match and help him make those attacking runs consistently.
reviews.cons: No significant weakness. He's not the strongest player physically, but with his pace, dribbling and quick movement, it isn't really a problem.
reviews.verdict: Pelé is just ridiculous at CAM. He's quick, smooth, clinical and has that perfect 5 star/5 star combo that makes him a nightmare to defend. Trickster Lv.2 makes his skills even more fun to use, while his passing and playmaking make him more than just a goal scorer. There's honestly very little to complain about here.

reviews.name: Matheus Cunha
reviews.pros:
His shooting is one of the biggest advantages of this card. The Clinical Finisher PlayStyle improves his ability to place shots accurately from close and mid-range. 

* Cunha's dribbling is another major strength. His 4 star skill moves, good technical profile and 183 cm height give him a useful combination of close control and physical presence. 

* His passing is also reliable for a CAM. The Play Maker trait complements his role well. 

* He can also be used at LW or ST, giving him additional value for squads that require tactical flexibility.
reviews.cons:
The biggest concern is his pace, he does not have the explosive speed of the fastest meta attackers. 

* Given the current stage of the game, there are better alternatives available requiring advanced investment in terms of shards.
reviews.verdict: Matheus Cunha is a very good attacking CAM who excels through shooting, dribbling, positioning and creativity rather than raw pace or physical dominance. His Clinical Finisher PlayStyle, Long Shot Taker and Play Maker traits make him a genuine goal threat while still allowing him to contribute to build-up play. Overall, Cunha is a strong 120 OVR attacker, but he isn't quite a flawless meta option due to his lack of elite pace, 4 star weak foot and limited PlayStyle package.

reviews.name: Alexis Mac Allister
reviews.pros:
Mac Allister's passing is one of his strongest qualities, allowing him to distribute the ball effectively and support midfield build-up. 

* His dribbling helps him maintain control and keep possession under pressure. 

* His positioning helps him find useful spaces in midfield and provide passing options. 

* His High/High work rate allows him to contribute actively in both attack and defence. 

* His Bullet Pass PlayStyle improves the accuracy and speed of driven ground passes, making his quick distribution more effective.
reviews.cons:
His pace can feel limited when covering large areas of midfield or tracking faster players. 

* His turning can feel slightly heavy when quickly changing direction under pressure. 

* His 3-star skill moves limit his ability to perform advanced dribbling moves in tight situations. 

* His 3-star weak foot can affect his consistency when passing or shooting on his weaker side.
reviews.verdict: Mac Allister is a solid CM with good passing, dribbling, positioning, and a useful High/High work rate. His Bullet Pass PlayStyle makes his quick ground distribution more effective, but his lack of pace, slightly heavy turning, 3-star skill moves, and 3-star weak foot hold him back from being a top-tier CM. At 7.3/10, he is a decent option but has some noticeable limitations.

reviews.name: Yannick Carrasco
reviews.pros:
Yannick Carrasco's pace makes him dangerous when attacking space and running at defenders from the left side. 

* His dribbling helps him carry the ball forward comfortably and create space in one-on-one situations. 

* His agility and close control make him difficult to dispossess when moving through tight areas. 

* His shooting is reliable enough to threaten the goal from inside and around the box. 

* His attacking movement helps him find useful spaces and make dangerous runs in the final third. 

* His Accelerator PlayStyle improves his acceleration without the ball, making his off-the-ball runs more effective.
reviews.cons:
His physicality can sometimes be an issue against stronger defenders. 

* His passing can be inconsistent when attempting difficult final-third passes. 

* His 4-star weak foot can occasionally affect his consistency when finishing or passing on his weaker side.
reviews.verdict: Yannick Carrasco is a quick and technical winger who offers good pace, dribbling, agility, and attacking movement. His Accelerator PlayStyle adds value to his off-the-ball runs, helping him create separation and attack spaces effectively. Although his physicality, passing, and weak foot have some limitations,he is a solid LW option who can be very effective for players who enjoy direct and mobile attacking wingers.

reviews.name: Zinedine Zidane
reviews.pros:
An elite CM with incredible all-round quality and playmaking ability. 

* Good pace helps him make attacking runs and recover quickly when needed. 

* Passing is absolutely brilliant, with Tiki Taka making his short passing and build-up play even better. 

* Long passes and through balls are extremely accurate and effective. 

* Long shots are deadly, while Power Shot makes his efforts from distance even more dangerous. 

* Shooting and finishing are excellent, with 5 star weak foot making him reliable from either side. 

* Ball control is excellent, while his dribbling feels smooth and comfortable. 

* Can contribute defensively with useful interceptions and tackles, even though he's not a defensive midfielder. 

* Can also play as CAM, giving him great attacking versatility.
reviews.cons:
Not as agile or smooth as some of the smaller attacking midfielders. 

* At nearly 70K shards, he's extremely expensive. 

* His playstyle selection could have been better, as Finesse Expert, Rapid, or Trickster would have added much more to his gameplay.
reviews.verdict: A phenomenal playmaker with elite passing, dangerous long shots, and 5* weak foot. He's an incredible card, but the huge shard cost and lack of more impactful attacking playstyles make him harder to justify.

reviews.name: Tijjani Reijnders
reviews.pros:
Turning away from pressure and carrying possession feels natural. 

* His passing makes him ideal for quick combinations and switching the point of attack. 

* He's capable of arriving late and producing a quality finish rather than being purely a passer. 

* He can contribute to buildup, progression and attacking phases without feeling like a specialist in only one area.
reviews.cons:
Against aggressive, powerful midfielders, he can struggle to impose himself in direct battles. 

* He'll help defensively, but he's not the CM you buy specifically to destroy attacks. 

* Shooting is good when given the right opportunity, but don't expect him to turn every half-chance into a goal. 

* His tendency to contribute going forward means he isn't always the safest option if you need your CM to sit back.
reviews.verdict: Reijnders is a midfield accelerator, smooth, quick and excellent at turning possession into forward momentum.  He’s at his best when you want your CM to carry the ball, link attacks and keep the game flowing, rather than sit back and defend. His technical quality makes him genuinely enjoyable in H2H, and community feedback also consistently points toward his playmaking and dribbling as standout qualities. The problem is that he doesn't quite have the defensive bite or physical presence to dominate every midfield battle.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Fernando Hierro
reviews.pros:
Physically very strong, and Bruiser Lv.2 makes him even harder to bully in physical duels. 

* Good pace for a CB, allowing him to comfortably keep up with fast attackers. 

* Solid defensively with excellent marking, tackling and well-timed blocks. 

* Very good in aerial duels thanks to his height, jumping and Power Header trait. 

* Passing is surprisingly impressive, and Bullet Pass is great for quick counters and 1v1 situations. 

* Good stamina with a Medium/High work rate, helping him stay effective throughout the match. 

* Dives Into Tackles and Power Header are both very useful traits for a CB.
reviews.cons:
Very expensive at 57,960 shards, with better-value options available. 

* No Anticipate PlayStyle, which is a noticeable weakness compared to top meta CBs.
reviews.verdict: Hierro is a very complete CB with excellent physicality, defending, pace and surprisingly good passing. Bruiser Lv.2 makes him a nightmare in physical battles, while Bullet Pass adds another dimension to his game. The lack of Anticipate and his huge shard cost hold him back from being a perfect CB, but he's still a top-tier option if you have the resources.

reviews.name: Carlos Alberto
reviews.pros:
His defending is absolutely top tier. Tackles, interceptions and marking all feel very reliable, and Anticipate makes his standing tackles even better. 
* Very strong physically and doesn't get bullied easily in duels. 
* Pace is excellent for a CB, while Accelerator Lvl 2 helps him make quick recovery runs. 
* High attacking and defensive work rates make him very active on both ends of the pitch while using as a fullback too. 
* Passing is a quite good for a defender. His short and long passing feel reliable for building out from the back. 
* Great positioning and awareness. He reads situations well and is usually where you need him. 
* Dives Into Tackles and Acrobatic Clearance are useful in those last-second defensive situations. 
* Works really well at both CB and RB, giving the card great versatility.
reviews.cons: No significant weekness.
reviews.verdict:
C. Alberto is an elite defensive option with great pace, defending, physicality and passing. 

* He's excellent at CB and can easily cover RB too.

reviews.name: Ronald Araujo
reviews.pros:
His Bruiser Level 1 PlayStyle is a major advantage. It improves his strength during physical battles, allowing him to compete aggressively with powerful strikers and wingers. 

* His Medium/High work rate is ideal for a centre-back. He is naturally more focused on defensive duties and is less likely to make unnecessary attacking movements. 

* Araújo's 6'2" height also gives him good reach and makes him reliable against crosses, long balls and aerial situations. 

* His Dives Into Tackles trait complements his aggressive defensive style, making him more proactive when challenging attackers. 

* His ability to play RB as an alternate position adds useful squad flexibility, especially if you need to make tactical changes during a match.
reviews.cons:
Some premium CBs offer multiple defensive PlayStyles, which can provide more specialised advantages. 

* Although his physicality is excellent, his recovery pace may not be enough to comfortably correct every mistake against extremely fast 
attackers.
reviews.verdict: Ronald Araújo is a very strong 120 OVR CB for players who prefer an aggressive and physical style of defending. His 6'2" frame and strong defensive profile make him particularly effective against physical forwards. His biggest strength is his ability to step into challenges and win physical battles. He is the type of CB who can disrupt an attack early rather than simply sitting deep and waiting for the striker to make a mistake. Overall, Araújo is an excellent choice if you want a powerful, aggressive CB who can dominate direct duels. Pairing him with a calmer, faster cover CB would make the defensive pairing even stronger.

reviews.name: Robin Koch
reviews.pros:
Robin Koch's physicality helps him compete well in defensive duels and deal with strong attackers. 

* His defensive positioning allows him to maintain his position and contribute to a solid defensive structure. 

* His aerial ability makes him useful when dealing with crosses and set pieces. 

* His Precision Header PlayStyle makes headers, passes, and clearances slightly faster and more accurate, improving his effectiveness in aerial situations.
reviews.cons:
His pace can feel limited when trying to recover against fast attackers. 

* His turning and agility can feel heavy when dealing with quick, skillful forwards. 

* His passing can feel less effective when under heavy pressure. 

* His overall mobility can make him vulnerable when defending large spaces behind the defensive line.
reviews.verdict: Robin Koch is a physically solid centre-back with good defensive positioning and aerial ability. His Precision Header PlayStyle adds value to his heading and defensive clearances. However, his limited pace and mobility can be noticeable against faster attackers, while his overall gameplay does not feel as effective as higher-rated CB options. At 7.3, he is a usable option, but there are generally better choices available for most squads.

reviews.name: Nico Schlotterbeck
reviews.pros:
He has decent pace for a centre-back, and the Level 1 Accelerator PlayStyle helps him get that extra burst of pace when he needs to catch up to attackers. 

* His reactions are another strong point. He can react quickly to loose balls, rebounds, sudden changes in direction and attackers trying to make runs behind the defensive line. 

* His defensive ability is very solid overall. He can make reliable tackles, interceptions and challenges against opposing attackers. 

* Physicality is also one of his better attributes. 

* The Dives Into Tackles trait is another positive addition.
reviews.cons:
The High/High work rates are decent, but they are not ideal for a CB. A Medium/High work rate would provide better balance, while Low/High is generally the best setup for a more defensively disciplined centre-back. 

* More importantly, constantly moving up and down the field can drain his stamina significantly faster, making the stamina issue even more noticeable later in the game.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Nico Schlotterbeck is a solid and aggressive CB with good recovery pace, strong reactions, reliable defending and good physicality. The Level 1 Accelerator PlayStyle helps compensate for situations where his High/High work rates pull him out of position, allowing him to recover quickly. However, his stamina and work rates are definitely something you need to keep in mind.

reviews.name: Ronald Koeman
reviews.pros:
He has good pace for a centre-back, also makes his alternate CDM position much more usable, as he has enough mobility to cover space in midfield and contribute defensively. 

* His shooting ability is surprisingly decent for a CB, especially when using his strong foot. 

* The Level 1 Power Shot PlayStyle can also make his long-range efforts more dangerous. And considering the kind of player Koeman was in real life, his ability to step up and take shots feels quite fitting for this card. 

* He is also decent at playmaking. 

* Defensively, Koeman is very reliable. His tackling and defensive positioning are good, while Level 1 Anticipate helps improve his ability to win the ball cleanly. 

* He also has the Dives Into Tackles trait, making him more aggressive and effective when challenging attackers. 

* His physicality is another positive.
reviews.cons: The Medium/High work rates are the biggest concern with this card. As a CB, the attacking work rate can sometimes affect his positioning, causing him to move forward or be less disciplined defensively.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Ronald Koeman is a very unique CB card. He offers good pace, strong defending, physicality, decent passing, and even the ability to score from distance, which is something you rarely get from a centre-back. The work rates are definitely something to consider if you're using him as a CB, but if you can manage his positioning or pair him with a more defensive CB, Koeman can be a very solid option.

reviews.name: Matthijs De Ligt
reviews.pros:
Matthijs de Ligt's physicality makes him strong in defensive duels and difficult for attackers to push past. 

* His tackling is effective, allowing him to make strong challenges and win possession. 

* His defensive awareness helps him read attacking situations and position himself well. 

* His aerial ability makes him a strong presence when dealing with crosses and set pieces. 

* His height and strength help him deal effectively with physical strikers. 

* His Bruiser PlayStyle increases his strength during physical battles, making him even more dominant in defensive duels.
reviews.cons:
His low pace can be a major weakness, making it difficult for him to recover against very fast attackers. 

* His turning and agility can feel slightly heavy when dealing with quick, agile forwards. 

* He can feel slightly vulnerable when defending large spaces behind the defensive line.
reviews.verdict: Matthijs de Ligt is a physically dominant and defensively strong centre-back with good tackling, aerial ability, and defensive awareness. His Bruiser PlayStyle further improves his effectiveness in physical battles, making him particularly useful against strong strikers. However, his limited pace and heavier turning can be noticeable against quick attackers, especially when defending a high line with plenty of space behind him. At 7.7, he is a solid defensive CB, but he may feel less comfortable than faster and more mobile options in certain gameplay situations.

reviews.name: Cesc Fabregas
reviews.pros:
An excellent playmaker with world-class passing ability. 

* Short passing is flawless, while through balls are extremely accurate and effective. 

* Long passing and ball distribution are excellent, making him great for build-up play. 

* Tiki Taka playstyle further improves his quick passing and combination play. 

* Dribbling and ball control are excellent, with great agility and smooth movement. 

* Good pace makes him feel surprisingly quick on the ball. 

* Finishing is brilliant with both feet, especially inside the box. 

* Shooting is very good with his strong foot, while close and mid-range efforts are reliable with either foot. 

* Good height and physicality make him capable of holding the ball and competing in duels. 

* Defensive contribution is surprisingly good, giving him more all-round value. 

* Long Passer and Playmaker traits perfectly suit his style of play. 

* Can play as CAM and ST, making him a very flexible attacking option.
reviews.cons:
4 star stamina is a noticeable issue, as he can struggle to maintain his intensity throughout the match. 

* 4 star weak foot is reliable for close and mid-range shots, but long-range efforts with it aren't very impressive. 

* At around 22K shards, he's good value, but there are already several strong cheaper options, while saving a little more can get you better-performing cards.
reviews.verdict: A brilliant passer and smooth playmaker with excellent finishing, dribbling, and useful versatility. He's a very good card for his price, but with so many strong alternatives available, he's not an absolute must-have.

reviews.name: Raphael Varane
reviews.pros:
A very fast and reliable centre-back with excellent recovery speed. 

* Anticipate Lv.2 is a brilliant addition, making his positioning, interceptions, and tackles even more effective. 

* Precision Header Lv.1 is also useful, especially in aerial duels and defensive clearances. 

* Marking and interceptions are excellent, while his tackling is very solid. 

* Great recovery ability allows him to catch up with fast attackers and recover his position quickly. 

* Good height and physicality make him strong in both ground and aerial duels. 

* Dives Into Tackles and Long Passer traits add extra value to his defensive and passing gameplay.
reviews.cons: Ball Playing Defender skill points aren't ideal for a CB and can be a slight downside, especially for players who prefer more defensive-focused skill points.
reviews.verdict: A fast, strong, and highly reliable CB with an excellent Anticipate Lv.2 playstyle. His recovery speed and defensive consistency make him a top-tier option, with the skill-point selection being the only notable concern.

reviews.name: Abedi Pele
reviews.pros:
A decent attacking option with good overall gameplay. 

* Pace is very good, while his agility makes his movements quick and responsive. 

* Dribbling and ball control are reliable, allowing him to handle the ball comfortably in tight spaces. 

* Shooting and finishing are very good, with reliable accuracy in front of goal. 

* Passing and crossing are brilliant, making him useful in build-up and wide attacking situations. 

* His 5'9 height is good enough, and his physicality feels decent despite not being outstanding. 

* Can also play as LM and CAM, with CAM surprisingly being his most dominant position.
reviews.cons:
4 star weak foot can be a downside, especially at LW where having a strong right foot is important. 

* Whipped Crosser is his only notable playstyle and is mainly useful for crossing. A stronger attacking playstyle would have made the card much more effective. 

* Overall, he doesn't feel particularly special compared to the other options available. Spending around 40K League Tokens on him may not be worthwhile when better cards are already available.
reviews.verdict: A solid and versatile attacker with good pace, dribbling, passing, and finishing, but he lacks the standout qualities needed to justify his high token cost. I'd recommend saving the 40K League Tokens for future options.

reviews.name: Ramires
reviews.pros:
A very strong and complete CDM with excellent defensive ability. 

* Tackling is precise and well timed, while his marking and interceptions are also very reliable. 

* Anticipate playstyle makes his defending even more dominant, especially when stepping in for tackles and interceptions. 

* Amazing pace allows him to catch up with attackers quickly and make dangerous attacking runs himself. 

* Physicality is excellent, making him reliable in duels and difficult to push off the ball. 

* Short and long passing are both very good, giving him excellent overall ball distribution. 

* Surprisingly, his dribbling and ball control are also excellent for a CDM, making him comfortable carrying the ball forward. 

* Strong-foot shooting and finishing are decent enough to contribute in attacking situations. 

* Can also play as CM and RM, giving him good versatility.
reviews.cons:
Chip Shot playstyle isn't very useful for a CDM. A stronger passing or defensive playstyle would have made him more special. 

* 3 star weak foot slightly limits his passing and attacking reliability in certain situations.
reviews.verdict: A brilliant all-round CDM with elite pace, strong defending, excellent passing, and surprisingly good dribbling. Anticipate makes him even more reliable defensively, while his versatility adds plenty of value.

reviews.name: Vini Jr.
reviews.pros:
An absolutely unstoppable winger with insane pace. 

* Rapid playstyle makes his speed even more dangerous, allowing him to explode past defenders and make deadly runs. 

* Trickster playstyle combined with 5* skill moves makes his skill moves incredibly effective, with a high stun rate and excellent creativity. 

* Dribbling and ball control are world-class, while his agility makes him feel extremely smooth and responsive. 

* Finishing is excellent, even with his weak foot, making him very reliable inside the box. 

* Long-range shooting is also very good with his strong foot. 

* Can also play as LM and ST, giving him great versatility.
reviews.cons: Weak-foot long shots can still be inconsistent at time.
reviews.verdict: An explosive and almost unstoppable winger. The combination of Rapid, Trickster, 5 star skill moves, elite dribbling, and reliable finishing makes Vini Jr. one of the most dangerous attackers available.

reviews.name: Riccardo Orsolini
reviews.pros:
He gets forward well and can create separation from full-backs. 

* Dribbling is probably his most enjoyable quality. He feels comfortable changing direction and carrying the ball into the final third. 

* Cutting inside from RM can produce some very dangerous shooting opportunities.
reviews.cons:
Strong full-backs can disrupt him when they get shoulder-to-shoulder. 

* Don't expect him to consistently track back and shut down the flank. 

* Finishing can feel inconsistent when the chance isn't created from his preferred attacking situations. 

* Not quite explosive enough to feel elite against the fastest meta full-backs. 

* Can go quiet when your opponent completely closes the wing and forces you to attack through the middle.
reviews.verdict: Orsolini is good… but he's not a “WOW, I need this RM” card. He's enjoyable when you play quick, wide and aggressive, and his dribbling, passing and two-footedness make him more versatile than the rating might suggest. But once you put him against the top-tier RMs, you start noticing the difference, especially in physical presence, defensive contribution and consistency. I'd call him a good card rather than a must-have. If you already have a strong RM, Orsolini probably isn't the upgrade that changes your team. But if you want a smooth, attacking wide midfielder who can create something out of nowhere, he'll definitely give you some fun games.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Jobe Bellingham
reviews.pros:
Jobe Bellingham's pace allows him to cover ground well and support both attacking and defensive transitions. 

* His physicality helps him compete in midfield duels and hold off opponents. 

* His stamina allows him to stay active throughout the match and contribute consistently. 

* His dribbling makes him comfortable carrying the ball through midfield and progressing play. 

* His ball control helps him retain possession when under pressure. 

* His movement allows him to find useful spaces and support attacks from midfield. 

* His Relentless PlayStyle reduces fatigue loss during play, helping him maintain his performance for longer.
reviews.cons:
His finishing and 3-star weak foot can affect his consistency when taking chances, especially when shooting on his weaker side. 

* His turning can feel slightly heavy when quickly changing direction under pressure. 

* His passing can sometimes feel inconsistent when attempting difficult progressive passes. 

* His defensive positioning can occasionally be inconsistent when tracking runners.
reviews.verdict: Jobe Bellingham is a hardworking and versatile midfielder who offers good pace, physicality, stamina, dribbling, and mobility. His Relentless PlayStyle helps him maintain his energy throughout the match, making him useful in a high-intensity midfield role. However, his finishing and 3-star weak foot, heavier turning, inconsistent progressive passing, and occasional positioning issues limit his overall effectiveness. At 7.2, he is a decent all-round CM, but he lacks the consistency and technical quality of the stronger meta midfielders.

reviews.name: Joelinton
reviews.pros:
He feels strong in midfield and is difficult to simply brush aside in shoulder-to-shoulder situations. 
* He's surprisingly good at getting involved in tackles and disrupting attacks rather than being a passenger without the ball. 
* His work rate makes him useful during transitions, helping both your defence and attack.
reviews.cons:
3 star weak foot, this becomes noticeable when you're under pressure and need a quick pass or touch on his weaker side. 
* 3 star Skill Moves, limits his ability to escape tight midfield pressure creatively. 
* He can cover ground, but he doesn't have that instant burst that the best modern CMs use to create separation. 
* He's good in several areas, but there isn't one part of his gameplay that makes you think “this guy is different.” 
* He'll contribute going forward, but he's unlikely to consistently decide matches with goals or killer creativity.
reviews.verdict:
Joelinton is the definition of an “okay at everything, exceptional at nothing” midfielder.
He's strong, useful defensively, capable in possession and will work all game, but at 118 OVR, you expect a CM to give you something special. The 3 star weak foot and skill moves become even more noticeable when compared with higher-end midfielders, and his lack of explosiveness prevents him from feeling truly elite. He's not a bad card at all, he's just a card you'll eventually want to upgrade. If you already have him, he can absolutely do a job; if you're choosing a new CM for your main squad, I'd look elsewhere before spending heavily on him.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Kanu
reviews.pros:
When he gets a clean opportunity, he's capable of putting the ball away consistently. 
* His size helps him shield the ball and gives defenders something substantial to deal with. 
* He isn't completely clunky, and his touches can be surprisingly decent for a striker of his build.
reviews.cons:
This is probably the biggest problem. The numbers look exciting, but his acceleration and turning don't give you that “ST” feeling. 
* Instead of feeling powerful, he can feel awkward when you're trying to change direction quickly. 
* There are moments where you expect him to attack the space, but he doesn't make the run you want. 
* If your attacking style relies on rapid turns, skill chains and quick directional changes, Kanu can feel a step behind. 
* With cards offering similar attacking numbers while feeling considerably smoother, Kanu doesn't quite justify his 120 OVR purely through gameplay.
reviews.verdict: Kanu is the definition of “don’t judge a striker by his card.” On paper, everything screams elite striker, but in-game he feels noticeably less impressive. His size gives him a presence, and when he gets into a good position, he can absolutely finish. But the lack of sharpness in his movement and turning makes him feel a level below the current top STs. He isn't bad, far from it. But at 120 OVR, you expect a striker who can take over games, and Kanu doesn't consistently give you that feeling.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Garrincha
reviews.pros:
Garrincha's dribbling is excellent, allowing him to beat defenders and create space in one-on-one situations. 

* His pace helps him quickly attack open spaces and get past defenders on the flank. 

* His agility and close control make him very difficult to dispossess in tight areas. 

* His skill moves give him plenty of options to change direction and beat defenders. 

* His acceleration allows him to quickly create separation from opponents. 

* His attacking movement helps him find useful spaces around the final third. 

* His Rapid PlayStyle improves his acceleration while sprint dribbling, making him even more dangerous when carrying the ball at speed.
reviews.cons:
His physicality can sometimes be an issue against stronger defenders. 

* His aerial ability can be limited when competing for balls against taller players. 

* As a RW, having a 5-star left foot would have made him even more effective when cutting inside and finishing.
reviews.verdict: Garrincha performs well in-game and can be a lot of fun to use, especially for players who enjoy skilful and direct wingers. His excellent dribbling, pace, agility, and Rapid PlayStyle make him a dangerous RW. However, his physicality, aerial ability are noticeable limitations. The card itself is good, but the 118 OVR and P2P requirement bring down its overall value. If you have the resources and like Garrincha's playstyle, he can definitely be worth using.

reviews.name: Piotr Zieliniksi
reviews.pros:
Zielinski's biggest strength is his playmaking ability. He can contribute well to build-up play with his passing and creativity. 

* Level 1 Bullet Pass, this skill point improves the speed and sharpness of his passes. 

* The 5-star weak foot is a major advantage because he can pass and shoot comfortably with either foot. It makes his distribution more unpredictable and removes the need to constantly adjust onto his stronger foot. 

* He has good physicality for a CM, allowing him to handle physical challenges better and hold his ground when competing for possession.
reviews.cons:
His pace is a clear weakness for a CM. He can struggle to cover ground quickly, especially when transitioning between attack and defence or trying to catch up with faster midfielders. 

* His shooting is usable, but it does not feel as dangerous as you would expect from a midfielder with a 5-star weak foot. 

* His stamina is underwhelming, he may struggle to maintain the same level of movement and involvement throughout the game. 

* Zielinski's movement is one of his biggest problems. 

* Being only 119 OVR means Zielinski does not receive the full skill-point benefits available to players at 120 OVR or above.
reviews.verdict: Overall, he is a decent playmaking CM, but the sluggishness and lack of athleticism prevent him from being a truly well-rounded midfielder.

reviews.name: Xavi Simons
reviews.pros:
He is not slow, but his speed is more adequate than exceptional. 

* His strong-foot shooting is a reliable part of his game, allowing him to finish chances from inside and around the box.  

* Simons offers useful creativity in the attacking midfield position, with decent passing and link-up play. 

* The level 1 Tiki Taka skill point complements this by making his quick passing combinations more effective. 

* His dribbling is one of his better qualities.
reviews.cons:
His physicality is a noticeable weakness, meaning stronger defenders can push him off the ball fairly easily. 

* The 4-star weak foot can reduce his consistency when shooting or passing from his weaker side. 

* Although his pace is decent for a CAM, it does not really stand out at this level. A higher pace stat would have made him more effective at carrying the ball forward and creating separation from defenders.
reviews.verdict: Overall, he is a good technical CAM for players who value smoothness and combination play, but he lacks the pace, physicality and weak-foot reliability needed to make him a truly complete attacking midfielder.

reviews.name: Bukayo Saka
reviews.pros:
Saka has very good pace for a RW, allowing him to accelerate past fullbacks and create space on the right side. 

* The level 1 Rapid skill point further improves his ability to burst forward and makes his pace more useful in one-on-one situations. 

* His shooting is reliable enough to contribute goals, especially when cutting inside from the right. 

* Playmaking is one of Saka's biggest strengths. 

* The level 1 Whipped Cross makes his deliveries into the box more dangerous and accurate. 

* Saka feels responsive and comfortable while dribbling. 

* He has enough physicality to handle some contact from defenders and maintain possession.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot can limit Saka when he has to finish or pass with his weaker foot. 

* The Wide Playmaker skill point feels misplaced on a natural RW like Saka because it is much more suitable for LMs and RMs, who operate more like midfielders. 

* For this card, an Inside Forward or Inverted Winger skill point would have suited his attacking role much better and made him more effective when cutting inside.
reviews.verdict: Overall, he is a well-rounded and enjoyable winger, particularly for players who value pace, smoothness and chance creation, but his skill point choice holds him back from being a more complete endgame RW.

reviews.name: Lorenzo Pellegrini
reviews.pros:
Lorenzo Pellegrini's passing is very good, allowing him to link up with teammates and create chances from central areas. 

* His shooting is reliable, especially when he gets space around the edge of the box. 

* His ball control helps him keep possession and combine effectively in tight areas. 

* His physicality gives him enough strength to handle challenges and maintain possession. 

* His Tiki Taka PlayStyle makes ground passes faster and more accurate while reducing the receiver's trapping difficulty.
reviews.cons:
Despite having good dribbling stats, his in-game dribbling can feel heavy, especially when turning under pressure. 

* His 3-star skill moves limit his ability to perform advanced dribbling techniques and create space.
reviews.verdict: Lorenzo Pellegrini is a technical CAM who mainly relies on passing and shooting. His Tiki Taka PlayStyle makes his quick combination play even more effective, especially when linking midfield with attack. While his dribbling stats are good, the heavier in-game feel and 3-star skill moves can make him less responsive in tight situations. At 7.6, he is a decent creative CAM, but his lack of mobility and smoothness can make him less effective than more agile meta options.

reviews.name: Ferran Torres
reviews.pros:
His pace is good, and the Rapid playstyle helps him feel more explosive when sprinting and knocking the ball forward. 

* Dribbling feels smooth overall. His agility and ball control make him comfortable when carrying the ball down the wings. 

* Finesse Shot have decent curve finish well when cutting inside from the left. 

* Positioning is quite good. He makes useful attacking runs and generally finds good spaces around the box. 

* His height and physical build are also helpful. He doesn't feel too weak in physical battles and can hold his own against defenders. 

* Versatile he can comfortably cover LW, ST and RW depending on your formation.
reviews.cons:
Finishing can feel inconsistent at times, especially compared to the top-tier attackers. 

* He can also feel a little less responsive when making very tight turns compared to the more agile wingers.
reviews.verdict: Ferran Torres is a solid and versatile winger with good pace and dribbling. He's a good option if you want a flexible attacker, but there are better choices for pure performance.

reviews.name: Eric Cantona
reviews.pros:
His shooting is amazing. Finishing feels really good both inside and outside the box, and he can comfortably score from different shooting situations. 

* Physically, he's very strong, especially with Bruiser Lv2. He doesn't lose the ball easily and can hold off defenders during physical challenges. 

* He does a great job of getting past challenges and holding onto the ball. Even when defenders get close, he can use his strength to keep possession. 

* His pace is good. He's not the most explosive striker, but considering his build, he moves well enough and doesn't feel slow when making runs. 

* The 5 star skill move are a big advantage, especially because it allows to use advanced skill moves like the Elastico. 

* His positioning is quite good. He generally makes useful runs and finds himself in good positions around the box. 

* His aerial ability is excellent. His heading is very reliable, and he can comfortably score from crosses, making him a big threat in the air.
reviews.cons:
He feels quite heavy on the ball. He's not particularly agile, and his dribbling isn't one of the strongest parts of the card. 

* The skill-move stun isn't that great, so even with 5 star skills, beating defenders purely through skill moves can sometimes be difficult. 

* His pace isn't very explosive, which can make it harder to create separation from defenders after certain skill moves.
reviews.verdict:
Cantona is a strong and reliable ST with amazing shooting, physicality and aerial ability. 

His heavy movement and lack of agility hold him back from being elite, but Bruiser Lv2 makes him very difficult to dispossess. 

Overall, a very effective striker with multiple ways to score.

reviews.name: George Best
reviews.pros:
His pace is absolutely elite. Best feels very quick on the ball and has the acceleration to easily create separation from defenders. 

* Dribbling is one of his biggest strengths. He feels smooth, responsive and very comfortable when changing direction or carrying the ball at speed. 

* Trickster Lv2 is a huge W. His skill moves feel much quicker and more effective, making it easier to beat defenders in 1v1 situations. 

* The 5 star Skill Moves are another massive advantage. You have access to advanced skill moves, giving him plenty of options when taking on defenders. 

* His shooting is very reliable. Finishing feels consistent inside the box, while his finesse shots are also dangerous thanks to the Finesse Expert playstyle. 

* Very good passing for a winger. He can link up well, play through balls and create chances rather than just relying on pace and dribbling. 

* His joystick response and ball control are just brilliant. He feels extremely quick and responsive on the joystick, making his movement and dribbling feel very smooth. 

* His positioning is also quite good. He makes intelligent runs and often finds himself in dangerous areas. 

* The versatility is a massive advantage. Being usable at RW, LW and CAM makes him much easier to fit into different formations and situations. 

* His stamina is also good enough to stay effective throughout the game, especially with how much he relies on movement and dribbling.
reviews.cons: His 4 star weak foot can sometimes affect finesse and finishing accuracy from the left foot at RW. He feels more effective at LW thanks to his strong foot advantage.
reviews.verdict: George Best is just superb. His pace, dribbling, 5 star skill move, shooting and versatility make him one of the most complete attacking options.

reviews.name: Antoine Griezmann
reviews.pros:
His strong-foot shooting is one of his better qualities, giving him reliable finishing when chances fall naturally onto his left foot. 

* Griezmann offers more creativity than a typical striker, with decent passing and link-up play allowing him to participate in build-up instead of simply staying in the box. 

* He feels comfortable and responsive while dribbling, credit goes to the false 9 skill point, making him easy to control in tight areas. 

* Griezmann has solid physicality for a striker, helping him handle contact and maintain possession when defenders put pressure on him.
reviews.cons:
While his pace is decent, it is not enough to make him a truly dangerous pace-based striker. Against faster defenders, he can struggle to create separation and may need to rely more on his movement and technical ability. 

* The 4-star weak foot can make his finishing less dependable when chances fall onto his weaker foot. 

* The level 1 Power Shot does not provide a major advantage against good goalkeepers. His normal strong-foot shooting is generally more reliable, so the Power Shot should be treated as an occasional option rather than a primary weapon.
reviews.verdict: Overall, he is a very good option for players who want a smooth and creative striker who can link up with the team, but he is not the ideal choice if you are looking for a fast, explosive ST who can constantly beat defenders through pace.

reviews.name: Andriy Shevchenko
reviews.pros:
Shevchenko has good enough pace for a striker, he may not be one of the fastest STs in the game, but his pace is definitely reliable. 

* His biggest strength is his finishing and overall shooting. 

* He can finish chances consistently, while the level 2 Power Shot gives him an extra threat from outside the box and makes his long-range shooting more effective. 

* Shevchenko has good physicality for a striker, helping him hold off defenders and stay on the ball when challenged.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot can occasionally affect his finishing and shooting consistency when chances fall onto his weaker foot. 

* His stamina is a noticeable weakness, he can become less effective as the game progresses. 

* Shevchenko does not feel particularly smooth or agile on the ball. His movement can feel a little stiff during turns and quick changes of direction, which makes him less enjoyable for players who prefer highly responsive and fluid strikers.
reviews.verdict: Shevchenko is a strong traditional striker with decent pace, good physicality and very good shooting, with his level 2 Power Shot adding another useful attacking weapon. However, the 4-star weak foot, average stamina and slightly rough movement prevent him from feeling like a truly complete striker.

reviews.name: Javier Mascherano
reviews.pros:
His defensive presence is noticeably stronger than most conventional CDMs. He actively gets involved when the opponent tries to play through the middle. 

* He's particularly good at stepping in, winning the ball and immediately turning defence into attack. 

* Once he wins possession, his passing is good enough to switch play or start a counter without unnecessarily slowing things down. 

* He can close down gaps and track midfield runners much better than you'd expect from a defensive specialist.
reviews.cons:
3 star Skill Moves, Don't expect fancy skill combinations when you're trying to escape pressure. 

* 3 star Weak Foot, On his weaker side, passing and especially shooting can become noticeably less trustworthy under pressure. 

* Against taller midfielders, he can occasionally feel vulnerable in aerial or shoulder-to-shoulder situations. 

* He can contribute going forward, but he's not the CDM you want arriving in the box looking for goals. 

* His defensive-minded movement is brilliant when you're protecting possession, but if you expect your CDM to constantly join attacks, he may feel too conservative.
reviews.verdict: Mascherano is a midfield enforcer, not a midfield artist. He excels at what a defensive midfielder is supposed to do, win the ball, break attacks, protect the backline and keep the midfield under control. His defensive presence makes him incredibly useful in H2H, especially when you want your CDM to stay disciplined. However, the 3 star weak foot, 3 star skill moves and smaller physical profile hold him back from being an elite all-round CDM. He's extremely effective in his role, but you'll definitely notice his limitations when you're trying to build attacks under pressure.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Patrick Vieira
reviews.pros:
Interceptions and tackles are probably his biggest in-game selling points. He has a habit of appearing exactly where your opponent wants to play the ball. 

* He can bully smaller midfielders and hold his ground when the match gets physical. 

* Excellent for recycling possession and switching play when you need to escape pressure. 

* His height makes him useful for winning midfield headers and defending set pieces.
reviews.cons:
3 star Skill Moves hurt his creativity, this is the biggest drawback. If you're someone who relies heavily on Lane Change/Roulette-style skill combinations, you'll definitely notice the limitation. 

* His size is fantastic defensively, but quick turns aren't his speciality. 

* He's much more valuable for controlling the midfield than being your primary chance creator. 

* In extremely congested areas, smaller and more agile CMs can feel noticeably smoother. 

* If you're looking for a CM who constantly creates spectacular attacking moments, Vieira may feel underwhelming.
reviews.verdict: Vieira is the bouncer of your midfield. He's not there to entertain, he's there to make sure nobody gets through. His defending, physical presence, recovery ability and passing make him extremely useful as a defensive CM/box-to-box midfielder. But the 3 star Skill Moves and heavier turning stop him from being as versatile and enjoyable on the ball as some of the more technical CMs in the current meta.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Harry Maguire
reviews.pros:
Attackers genuinely feel his presence in shoulder-to-shoulder situations. 

* When positioned correctly, his tackles and interceptions feel decisive rather than half-hearted. 

* Particularly effective when sitting deeper and defending crosses or direct attacks. 

* His size and physical profile make him a serious problem for strikers trying to win headers.
reviews.cons:
Once a very fast attacker gets beyond him, chasing from behind isn't where Maguire shines. 

* Quick direction changes can expose him if you overcommit. 

* He's capable of keeping possession, but he's not the CB I'd pick to dictate play from deep. 

* Pulling him too far forward can leave you exposed because he isn't built around recovery defending. 

* Pairing him with a quicker, more mobile CB can cover his biggest weakness and make the combination much stronger.
reviews.verdict: Maguire is basically a bouncer for your penalty box. He's not going to win every foot race, but if the attacker comes into his territory, good luck getting through him. For a deeper defensive setup, especially with a fast CB beside him, Maguire can be a very frustrating defender to play against. But if your style involves a high defensive line, aggressive CB switching and chasing rapid attackers, you'll notice his limitations.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Ian Rush
reviews.pros:
Excellent for counter-attacking football and getting behind the defensive line. 

* Once Rush gets into a proper shooting position, you can trust him to punish mistakes. 

* His positioning and runs make him dangerous without needing constant manual direction.
reviews.cons:
3 star Skill Moves is the BIG problem. This is what stops him from feeling like a true endgame/meta ST. You simply don't have the same attacking toolkit to beat a defender one-on-one. 

* Against a good manually controlled CB, creating that final yard of space can become frustrating. 

* When the defence sits deep, you can't rely on skill combinations to manufacture an opening. 

* He's much better for direct runs and quick combinations than for players who love taking on defenders individually. 

* He can finish and run, but he doesn't give you that complete feeling some of the elite 5 star attackers provide.
reviews.verdict: When you play direct, his pace, movement and finishing can be genuinely scary. But the moment you need to create something from nothing, the 3 star skill moves start showing their teeth. He's good, not broken. If you're a player who loves through balls, quick combinations and attacking space, Rush can absolutely cook. But if you're looking for a striker who can pick up the ball, turn a CB inside-out and create his own goal, he is not the one you want to keep in your team.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Virgil Van Dijk
reviews.pros:
Van Dijk feels massive at CB and does a great job of physically dominating attackers with his defensive presence. 

* Level 2 Anticipate is a huge advantage. His standing tackles feel much more reliable, and he can win the ball cleanly without constantly needing to commit to risky tackles. 

* His pace is surprisingly good for a CB. He can keep up with quicker attackers and recover well when caught out of position. 

* His defensive positioning is excellent. He generally stays where you want him to be and doesn't randomly abandon his defensive line. 

* Strength and physicality are another massive W. He can bully attackers off the ball and feels very difficult to beat in shoulder-to-shoulder situations. 

* His heading and aerial presence are really strong. He can deal with crosses and high balls while also being a threat from set pieces. 

* High defensive work rate suits him perfectly. He stays heavily involved defensively and constantly looks to make interceptions and challenges. 

* His reactions and awareness make a noticeable difference. He reacts quickly to loose balls and can recover when the situation becomes chaotic. 

* Bullet Pass is a nice bonus for building from the back. His driven ground passes are quick and accurate, making it easier to transition from defence into attack.
reviews.cons: No significant weakness.
reviews.verdict: Van Dijk feels like a proper endgame CB. His defending, physical presence, pace, aerial ability and Level 2 Anticipate make him incredibly reliable. He's especially good if you want a CB who can win physical battles, make clean tackles and recover against fast attackers.

reviews.name: Steven Gerrard
reviews.pros:
The biggest W with Gerrard is how well-rounded he feels as a CM. He can contribute in almost every area instead of being limited to just one role. 

* His passing is excellent. Short and long passes feel reliable, and Bullet Pass helps him move the ball quickly when you're trying to transition forward. 

* Gerrard is a genuine threat from outside the box, especially when you get some space around the edge of the area. 

* His pace is more than good enough for a CM. He doesn't feel slow when carrying the ball or tracking back. 

* Stamina is quite good for a box-to-box midfielder. He can stay involved throughout the game without feeling completely drained late on. 

* His High attacking work rate makes him very active going forward. He naturally gets into useful positions and can support attacks instead of just sitting behind the play. 

* His physicality is solid, so he doesn't feel completely helpless when challenged in midfield. He can hold his ground and compete for the ball. 

* His attacking output is really good. His shooting and finishing are among the best, making him a genuine goal threat rather than just a midfielder who creates chances. 

* His reactions and ball control feel reliable, which helps when receiving the ball under pressure and quickly moving it on. 

* Overall, he feels like a proper all-round midfielder who can contribute defensively, create chances and score from distance.
reviews.cons:
His Medium defensive work rate isn't ideal if you're using him primarily as a CDM. He can sometimes be less aggressive defensively compared to dedicated defensive midfielders. 

* Not the most agile midfielder around, so very quick turns in tight areas can sometimes feel a little heavy.
reviews.verdict: Gerrard is a very complete CM who gives you a bit of everything. His passing, shooting, pace, stamina and physical presence make him really useful in the middle of the pitch.

reviews.name: Josko Gvardiol
reviews.pros:
His versatility being able to play both LB and CB makes him extremely useful, especially if you need a reliable defensive option in multiple positions. 

* Defensively, he's very solid. His marking, standing tackles and awareness make him feel reliable when dealing with attackers, and he doesn't easily get beaten in defensive situations. 

* His physical presence is another big strength. The Bruiser playstyle helps him in physical battles, and he feels strong when shoulder-to-shoulder with attackers. 

* His reactions are also really good. He responds quickly to loose balls and sudden changes of direction, which helps a lot when defending manually. 

* 5 star weak foot is a huge bonus for an LB/CB. Passing and clearing with either foot feels much safer, especially when under pressure. 

* High attacking and defensive work rates make him more active on the pitch. He can support attacks from LB while still having the defensive work rate to recover. 

* Overall, he feels like a very complete defender who can comfortably fit into both LB and CB roles.
reviews.cons:
The Bruiser playstyle is useful, but having only one playstyle does make him feel slightly less flexible compared to some of the top defensive options with multiple playstyles. 

* His agility and balance aren't elite, so against very quick and skillful attackers he can occasionally feel a little less responsive.
reviews.verdict: Gvardiol is a very strong defensive option and the LB/CB versatility makes him even more valuable. He's fast, strong, defensively reliable and comfortable on both feet. As an LB, he's more defensive-minded than an attacking fullback, but as a CB, he can genuinely compete with some of the top options thanks to his pace, strength and defending.

reviews.name: Marouane Fellaini
reviews.pros:
Marouane Fellaini's physical presence makes him very effective in midfield duels and when shielding the ball. 

* His height gives him a strong presence in both midfield and attacking situations. 

* His aerial ability makes him useful when defending and attacking set pieces. 

* His stamina allows him to stay involved throughout the match and handle the physical demands of midfield. 

* His ball retention is useful when holding off opponents and protecting possession. 

* His shooting can be effective when he gets into good positions around the box. 

* His Bruiser PlayStyle increases his strength during physical battles, making him even harder to dispossess.
reviews.cons:
His pace can feel slow compared to more mobile midfielders. 

* His turning and agility can feel heavy when trying to react quickly in tight spaces. 

* His dribbling can feel less responsive under pressure. 

* His 3-star skill moves limit his ability to create space or beat opponents in tight situations.
reviews.verdict: Marouane Fellaini is a physical and aerially dominant midfielder who is particularly effective in duels and when shielding the ball. His body type and physical presence make him better suited to CDM than CM, where he can use his strength and defensive presence more effectively. The Bruiser PlayStyle further enhances his ability to dominate physical battles. However, his lack of mobility, heavy turning, and limited skill moves can be noticeable in a fast-paced midfield.He is best used as a physical CDM who can protect the defence and provide a strong presence in midfield.

reviews.name: Jamie Carragher
reviews.pros:
Jamie Carragher's defensive awareness makes him reliable at reading attacking situations and staying in position. 

* His physicality allows him to compete strongly with powerful forwards and win physical duels. 

* His tackling is effective, especially when challenging attackers directly. 

* His positioning is generally good, helping him maintain a solid defensive shape and close down dangerous spaces. 

* His composure helps him stay reliable when defending under pressure. 

* His Guardian PlayStyle improves hard tackle range and speed, while also helping him stop the ball directly at an opponent's feet.
reviews.cons:
His pace can feel noticeably slow, making it difficult to recover against fast attackers. 

* His turning and agility can feel heavy when dealing with quick, skillful forwards. 

* His positioning can occasionally become inconsistent and leave gaps at the back. 

* His aerial ability can be inconsistent, especially when competing against taller and stronger strikers.
reviews.verdict: Jamie Carragher is a physical and defensively focused centre-back who relies on tackling, defensive awareness, and physical duels. His Guardian PlayStyle further improves his hard tackles and helps him make stronger challenges around the ball. His positioning is generally good, although it can occasionally become inconsistent.However, his lack of pace, heavy turning, and inconsistent aerial ability can be noticeable against faster and more technical attackers.He is a usable defensive CB, but he doesn't offer the mobility and responsiveness of the better modern CB options.

reviews.name: Dominik Szoboszlai
reviews.pros:
His Power Shot Level 1 PlayStyle is a major advantage. It improves the accuracy and shot speed of power shots, making him a serious threat. 

* His Long Shot Taker trait complements Power Shot particularly well. 

* The 4 star weak foot is very useful for a CAM. He can pass and shoot with either foot, making him less predictable when operating centrally. 

* His 4 star skill moves provide enough variety to turn away from defenders, create shooting space and attack gaps around the penalty area. 

* His High/High work rate makes him extremely active. He can contribute to attacks while also dropping back to help during defensive transitions. 

* His 6'1" frame is another advantage for a CAM, giving him more physical presence than many smaller attacking midfielders.
reviews.cons:
He only has one additional PlayStyle, Power Shot. While it is highly useful, some premium CAMs offer multiple PlayStyles that influence passing, dribbling and chance creation. 

* His profile is more suited to shooting and midfield involvement than pure explosive dribbling. He may not feel as agile as smaller, highly technical CAMs.
reviews.verdict: Szoboszlai is a very strong 119 OVR CAM, particularly for players who want an attacking midfielder capable of contributing both creatively and as a long-range scoring threat. His biggest weakness is the lack of PlayStyle variety. Overall, Szoboszlai is best suited to players who like their CAM to participate heavily in the game, make runs, contribute defensively and threaten from distance.

reviews.name: Erling Haaland
reviews.pros:
The biggest advantage is his overall presence up front. He feels like a proper physical striker and defenders struggle to deal with him when he's running at them. 

* His pace is good. Rapid playstyle makes his acceleration even more noticeable, especially when attacking space and making runs behind the defence. 

* Finishing is one of his biggest strengths. He feels extremely reliable inside the box. 

* Shot power is another huge advantage. His strikes feel powerful and he can finish from outside the box 

* His physical presence is ridiculous. He is very difficult to push off the ball and can hold off defenders. 

* His aerial ability is also great. His height, jumping and Power Header trait make him a serious threat from crosses and set pieces. 

* His positioning is also very good. He makes intelligent runs and is usually in the right areas when you need him inside the box.
reviews.cons:
Passing could definitely be better. He's fine for simple link-up play, but he isn't the type of striker you want relying on for creative passes. 

* The 4 star weak foot can be noticeable at times, especially when he's forced to finish quickly from an awkward angle. 

* He's not the most agile striker. Quick turns and tight movements can feel a little heavier compared to smaller and more technical attackers. 

* His dribbling and skill moves feel a bit heavy in crowded areas. If you're someone who likes constantly changing direction with your ST, there are smoother options.
reviews.verdict: Haaland feels like a proper power striker. His pace, finishing, shot power, physical presence and aerial ability all make him a nightmare for defenders. He's not the smoothest or most technical striker, and the passing and weak foot hold him back slightly.

reviews.name: Alisson Becker
reviews.pros:
His height gives him good reach and makes him particularly reliable when dealing with shots aimed toward the corners and high areas of the goal. 

* His Rush Out Level 1 PlayStyle is a major advantage. It allows him to come off his line quickly to pressure attackers, which can be especially useful against through balls and one-on-one situations. 

* His Long Thrower trait is useful for quickly starting counterattacks after making a save. 

* Alisson also has a strong overall goalkeeper profile at 118 OVR, making him a competitive option for players looking for a reliable high-rated GK.
reviews.cons: There are other high-rated goalkeepers that may offer a more specialised combination of PlayStyles and attributes.
reviews.verdict: Alisson is a very solid 118 OVR goalkeeper, with his 6'4" height, 91 kg build. His biggest strength is his ability to combine a large goalkeeper frame with an aggressive Rush Out PlayStyle. This makes him particularly appealing for players who defend with a relatively high line and want their goalkeeper to react quickly to balls played behind the defence. Overall, Alisson is a dependable and versatile 118 OVR GK who should perform particularly well for players who value height, physical presence and aggressive rushing off the line.

reviews.name: Amad Diallo
reviews.pros:
Amad's dribbling makes him very effective at carrying the ball through tight spaces and beating defenders. 

* His pace allows him to quickly exploit spaces between the midfield and defence. 

* His agility and close control make him difficult to dispossess in one-on-one situations. 

* His acceleration helps him create separation from defenders and make quick attacking runs. 

* His shooting is reliable enough to be a consistent threat around the box. 

* His passing allows him to combine well with teammates and create chances from central areas. 

* His Accelerator PlayStyle improves his acceleration without the ball, making his attacking runs more effective.
reviews.cons:
His physicality can sometimes be an issue when facing stronger midfielders and defenders. 

* His lack of traits slightly limits his gameplay variety and overall attacking options. 

* His defensive contribution can feel limited when used in deeper midfield areas.
reviews.verdict: Amad is a technical and agile attacking midfielder who offers excellent dribbling, pace, acceleration, and good shooting. His close control makes him dangerous between the lines, while the Accelerator PlayStyle gives his off-the-ball movement an extra boost. He is also very effective at RM, where his pace, dribbling, and attacking movement can be used particularly well. Although his physicality,lack of traits and defencive contribution have some limitations, he is a strong and versatile attacking option who can perform very well at both CAM and RM.

reviews.name: Ruben Dias
reviews.pros:
His Bruiser Level 1 PlayStyle is a major advantage. It improves his strength during physical battles, making him more effective when challenging attackers and competing shoulder-to-shoulder. 

* At 6'2", Dias has good defensive reach and should perform well against crosses and aerial situations. 

* His Medium/High work rate is another strong point. He is more defensively disciplined than centre-backs with a High attacking work rate and is less likely to abandon his defensive position unnecessarily. 

* His Long Passer trait adds useful distribution from the back, allowing him to initiate attacks with longer passes.
reviews.cons:
He has only one additional PlayStyle, Bruiser. Some premium centre-backs offer multiple defensive PlayStyles, providing more specialised advantages. 

* His pace and mobility may not match the better options in game, which could become noticeable when defending against extremely quick attackers in high defensive lines.
reviews.verdict: Rúben Dias is a very reliable 119 OVR CB for players who want a physical and positionally disciplined defender. His biggest strength is his ability to deal with physical attackers. Bruiser complements his natural defensive profile extremely well. The main concern is that he doesn't offer the PlayStyle variety or potentially elite mobility of some of the best endgame CBs. Overall, Dias is a strong defensive CB who prioritises physical defending, positioning and reliability over flashy attributes. He is particularly suited to players who prefer a more traditional centre-back rather than an extremely aggressive or pace-focused defender.

reviews.name: John Barnes
reviews.pros:
Barnes has an excellent winger profile, combining pace, dribbling, shooting and physicality. 

* Rapid Level 1 is a major advantage, giving him more explosive acceleration during sprint dribbling and knock-ons. 

* His 4 star skill moves provide plenty of options for taking on defenders and creating space around the box. 

* The 4 star weak foot is very useful for a left winger. Barnes can pass and finish with either foot, making him less predictable when cutting inside. 

* His Finesse Shot and Outside Foot Shot traits give him multiple finishing options. 

* Flair is another useful attacking trait, complementing his technical ability and making him more capable of producing creative attacking actions. 

* His High/Medium work rate is well suited to an attacking winger. He is naturally inclined to stay involved in attacks without having the excessive defensive movement of a High/High player.
reviews.cons:
At his rating and given the current game meta, there are better options available 

* There is no additional PlayStyle beyond Rapid Level 1. While Rapid is highly useful, some top-tier wingers offer multiple PlayStyles that provide more specialised advantages.
reviews.verdict: Barnes is a very strong 120 OVR LW who combines the qualities of a direct winger with those of an inside forward. The biggest weakness is that he doesn't offer the PlayStyle variety of some premium wingers, while his High/Medium work rate limits his defensive contribution. However, these aren't major concerns if you're primarily looking for an attacking LW. Overall, Barnes is an excellent choice for players who want a direct, physical and technically capable winger who can cut inside, create chances and finish from different angles.

reviews.name: Alexander Isak
reviews.pros:
Alexander Isak's pace makes him very dangerous when attacking space behind the defensive line. 

* His finishing is reliable and allows him to convert chances effectively around the goal. 

* His height and physical presence help him compete with defenders and hold up the ball. 

* His dribbling and close control make him surprisingly comfortable for a tall striker. 

* His movement helps him find space and make dangerous runs in the final third. 

* His shooting technique gives him different ways to finish chances around the goal. 

* His Chip Shot PlayStyle gives chip shots a unique dipping trajectory with increased accuracy and shot speed, making him more effective when trying to beat the goalkeeper with chipped finishes.
reviews.cons:
His turning can feel slightly heavy when quickly changing direction. 

* Having a 5-star weak foot would have made him even more effective, especially when finishing from different angles and positions. 

* The Chip Shot PlayStyle is useful in certain situations, but a more attack-focused PlayStyle would have suited his striker profile better.
reviews.verdict: Alexander Isak is a tall and mobile striker who combines pace, finishing, dribbling, and physical presence effectively. His movement allows him to attack space well, while his close control makes him more versatile than many taller forwards. The Chip Shot PlayStyle can be useful in specific situations, but a more attack-focused PlayStyle would have added more value to his overall striker profile. Despite a few limitations, he remains a strong option for players who want a mobile striker with good finishing and physical presence.

reviews.name: Dirk Kuyt
reviews.pros:
This card combines attacking ability, passing, dribbling, defending and physicality, making him capable of contributing in almost every phase of play. 

* His High/High work rate is excellent for a box-to-box midfielder. He actively participates in attacks while also tracking back to help defensively. 

* Rapid Level 1 gives him more explosive acceleration during sprint dribbling and knock-ons. 

* Tiki Taka Level 2 means faster and more accurate ground passes make Kuyt excellent for quick combinations and possession-based football. 

* His 5 star weak foot is a massive advantage for a CM. He can pass, shoot and control the ball comfortably with either foot. 

* His 4 star skill moves are also very useful, giving him more options when trying to escape pressure or create space in midfield. 

* He should be capable of competing effectively in midfield duels without feeling too heavy on the ball. 

* He can play CM, RW and CAM, allowing you to use him in several positions without needing to change your squad.
reviews.cons:
His High/High work rate can occasionally work against him. He may push forward aggressively when you want your CM to remain deeper and protect the defence. 

* Although his physical profile is strong, he isn't a pure defensive midfielder.
reviews.verdict: Dirk Kuyt is one of the most complete box-to-box midfielders available at 122 OVR. His combination of High/High work rate, Rapid, Tiki Taka Level 2 and 5 star weak foot gives him very few obvious weaknesses.
