Overall, Kuyt is an excellent all-round CM with the versatility to contribute as a creator, ball carrier, scorer and defensive worker. He is particularly well suited to formations that require an active box-to-box midfielder.

reviews.name: Josip Stanisic
reviews.pros:
Josip Stanišić's defensive positioning helps him stay composed and deal with attacking threats effectively. 

* His physicality allows him to compete well with strong forwards and handle physical duels. 

* His pace gives him good recovery ability when attackers try to get in behind. 

* His passing is reliable for building from the back and keeping possession. 

* His defensive awareness helps him read attacking situations and maintain his position. 

* His Bullet Pass PlayStyle increases passing accuracy and speed without increasing the receiver's trapping difficulty, making his passes more effective during build-up play.
reviews.cons:
His dribbling can feel slightly stiff when carrying the ball under pressure. 

* His aerial ability can be less dominant against taller and stronger strikers. 

* His Bullet Pass PlayStyle is useful for build-up, but having a defensive-focused PlayStyle would have made him even more effective at CB.
reviews.verdict: Josip Stanišić is a reliable and composed centre-back who offers a good combination of physicality, pace, defensive awareness, and passing. His Bullet Pass PlayStyle is useful for building from the back, as it improves passing speed and accuracy without making the receiver's trapping more difficult. However, his aerial ability has some limitations, and a defensive-focused PlayStyle would have added even more value to his CB profile.Overall, he is a solid option for players who value defensive stability combined with quality build-up play.

reviews.name: Phil Foden
reviews.pros:
A silky-smooth RW with excellent attacking gameplay. 

* Trickster playstyle makes his skill moves feel extremely smooth, quick, and effective in 1v1 situations. 

* Dribbling and ball control are excellent, making him very comfortable in tight spaces. 

* Quick and agile with good pace, allowing him to create separation from defenders. 

* Finishing is excellent, while his overall shooting is also very reliable. 

* Passing is really good, with good crossing to support wide attacks. 

* Can also play as LW and CM, giving him useful versatility, although RW is clearly his best position.
reviews.cons:
At 5'7, his height and physicality aren't ideal, so he can sometimes struggle in physical duels. 

* He's definitely a very good card, but some of the other top attacking options currently offer slightly better overall gameplay.
reviews.verdict: A smooth and creative RW who excels with his dribbling, skill moves, passing, and finishing. Trickster makes him especially fun and effective, but his physical limitations and strong competition keep him just below the very top tier.

reviews.name: Gianluigi Donnarumma
reviews.pros:
Diving is brilliant, while his positioning and reactions are also top-tier. 

* Great height gives him excellent reach and presence inside the box. 

* Reflexes are very good, especially useful for close-range shots and quick reactions. 

* Handling is reliable, helping him avoid unnecessary rebounds. 

* Kicking and overall ball distribution are excellent, making him useful for starting attacks. 

* Deflector playstyle is a great addition, helping push dangerous shots away into safer areas. 

* Long Thrower trait is also useful for launching quick counterattacks.
reviews.cons: No major weaknesses. He's an excellent GK overall, although some of the other top goalkeepers can still feel slightly better in certain situations.
reviews.verdict: A complete and reliable goalkeeper with brilliant diving, positioning, reactions, and excellent distribution. Deflector and Long Thrower add even more value, making him one of the strongest GK options available.

reviews.name: Ricardo Quaresma
reviews.pros:
A very fun and creative winger with excellent attacking ability. 

* Dribbling and ball control are outstanding, while his 5 star skill moves make him extremely effective and silky smooth in 1v1 situations. 

* Very agile and responsive, with good pace and quick movements. 

* Finesse Expert playstyle gives his finishing a huge boost, and he can finish reliably with both feet. 

* Shooting is excellent overall, although weak-foot long shots can still be inconsistent. 

* His stronger right foot makes LW his ideal position, where he can cut inside and create dangerous chances. He can also play RW effectively. 

* Passing and crossing are both very good, making him useful in build-up and wide attacking situations.
reviews.cons:
4 star stamina can become an issue late in matches. After constant runs, he can lose stamina and become noticeably less effective. 

* He’s definitely a very good option, but some of the other top cards currently offer slightly better overall gameplay.
reviews.verdict: A smooth, agile, and highly creative winger with elite dribbling, 5 star skill moves, and excellent finishing. LW is definitely his best position, especially with his stronger right foot. The only real concern is his stamina.

reviews.name: Lucio
reviews.pros:
A fantastic CB with elite all-round defensive ability. 

* Very good pace helps him recover quickly and deal with fast attackers. 

* Tackling, marking, interceptions, and positioning are all excellent, with his challenges feeling well timed and reliable. 

* Bruiser and Anticipate playstyles are a perfect combination for a CB. 

* Excellent passing and ball distribution make him very comfortable building from the back. 

* Good height and physicality give him a dominant presence in both ground and aerial duels. 

* Dives Into Tackles trait is another great addition for a top CB, adding more aggression to his defensive gameplay. 

* Powerful Driven Free Kick is mostly situational, but can occasionally be useful when contributing to attacking set pieces.
reviews.cons: Ball Playing Defender skill points aren't ideal for a top-tier CB and can slightly affect his overall defensive gameplay compared to more suitable options.
reviews.verdict: An elite and extremely reliable centre-back with the perfect combination of pace, physicality, defending, and two excellent defensive playstyles. The Ball Playing Defender skill point is the only noticeable downside, but overall Lucio remains one of the strongest CB options available.

reviews.name: Yaya Toure
reviews.pros:
An absolute monster at CDM and one of the most complete midfielders available. 

* 5 star weak foot makes his passing, shooting, and finishing reliable from either side. 

* Max stamina is perfect for a midfielder who needs to contribute from top to bottom all game. 

* Defending is scary good, with perfectly timed tackles, excellent marking, interceptions, and incredible physical presence. 

* Bruiser playstyle helps him dominate physical duels and hold onto the ball under pressure. 

* Bullet Pass makes his driven ground passes faster and more accurate, which is extremely useful for build-up and quick attacks. 

* Great pace for a CDM, allowing him to cover huge spaces and recover quickly. 

* Dribbling and ball control are very good. He's not the most agile midfielder, but his size and physicality make up for it. 

* Great height and strength make him extremely difficult to push off the ball. 

* Passing, long shots, and finishing are all excellent, so he can contribute heavily in attack as well. 

* Can also play as CM and even CAM, where he remains surprisingly dangerous.
reviews.cons: His biggest issue is availability. He's a Box player requiring a huge amount of money to obtain, making him unrealistic for most players.
reviews.verdict: A complete midfield monster who can defend, create, carry the ball, and score. His combination of pace, physicality, 5 star weak foot, max stamina, Bullet Pass, and Bruiser makes him almost impossible to replace. If not for the extremely high cost, he'd be an easy 10/10 recommendation.

reviews.name: Marc Guehi
reviews.pros:
Guehi has decent reactions for a centre-back, allowing him to respond reasonably well to loose balls, sudden movements and changes in the attacking play. 

* His defending is solid enough to make him dependable in normal defensive situations. 

* The Lv. 1 Anticipate playstyle is particularly useful because it improves his ability to read attacking movements and time his tackles. 

* Guehi has decent physicality to compete with attackers and hold his ground in many situations.
reviews.cons:
His pace is definitely a con as he isn't that quick enough or doesn't have enough to keep up with top wingers and strikers 

* His height is one of the biggest concerns for a CB. Being shorter limits his effectiveness in aerial battles and makes defending crosses, corners and long balls more difficult against taller attackers. 

* Medium/Medium work rates aren't ideal for a centre-back because they can make his positioning and movement feel less aggressive than you'd want from a defensive player. 

* His stamina can become an issue over the course of a match, particularly if you're playing an aggressive defensive style. 

* This is a significant disadvantage. Despite being listed as a 124 CB, his underlying 119 OVR means he doesn't receive the same skill-point treatment as cards that are 120 OVR or above.
reviews.verdict: A decent CB on paper, but the combination of his physical limitations and nerfed skill points makes him difficult to recommend for a competitive endgame squad.

reviews.name: Jeremy Doku
reviews.pros:
Doku's pace is one of his biggest weapons. 

* The Lvl 1 Rapid playstyle further complements this by making his explosive acceleration even more dangerous. 

* His shooting is good enough to contribute consistently, especially when he gets into favourable positions. 

* Doku isn't just a player who relies on running down the wing. His passing and chance creation are good enough to contribute to build-up play. 

* This is another major strength. Doku feels very responsive when dribbling, making quick turns and changes of direction naturally.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot is a noticeable limitation for a winger. 

* His stamina can become problematic during matches where he is constantly sprinting, dribbling and making repeated runs. 

* Physicality is another weakness. Against strong fullbacks, Doku can struggle to maintain possession when challenged directly.
reviews.verdict: Doku is a classic explosive winger who is built around pace, dribbling and 1v1 ability. The Lv. 1 Rapid playstyle makes his speed even more dangerous, while his smoothness allows him to take full advantage of it. His 4-star weak foot, stamina and physicality prevent him from being completely flawless.

reviews.name: David De Gea
reviews.pros:
De Gea has very good diving, giving him the ability to cover a large area of the goal and make difficult saves. 

* His positioning is another major strength. 

* Strong reflexes are extremely important for a goalkeeper, especially against close-range finishes. De Gea is capable of reacting quickly to sudden shots and making saves when there is very little time to respond. 

* His reactions complement his reflexes nicely. 

* Good handling makes him more dependable when dealing with shots that he can get his hands to. 

* The Long Thrower trait is a useful bonus for starting counterattacks. 

* At 6'4", De Gea has very good height for a goalkeeper. His height gives him better coverage of the goal and should help him deal with shots toward the upper corners and crosses. 

* Deflector is a useful playstyle for a goalkeeper because it influences how he deals with shots that he cannot comfortably catch.
reviews.cons: This is the biggest issue with the card. Since the card is effectively 119 OVR, its skill points are nerfed compared with cards that are 120 OVR or higher.
reviews.verdict: Ignoring the OVR limitation, he's a very well-rounded GK; the nerfed skill points are what ultimately hold him back from being truly elite.

reviews.name: Kenny Dalglish
reviews.pros:
Dalglish has very good pace for a striker, giving him the acceleration and speed needed to make dangerous runs behind the defensive line. 

* This is easily the strongest part of the card. His finishing is extremely reliable because the 5-star weak foot means he can shoot confidently from either side without being heavily restricted by his preferred foot. 

* The Lvl 1 Finesse Expert and Finesse Shot trait make him particularly dangerous when attempting finesse finishes. 

* While Lvl 1 Clinical Finisher further improves his ability to convert chances inside and around the box. 

* His agility gives him a responsive and mobile feel in attack. 

* Good physicality adds another layer to his attacking game.
reviews.cons: His stamina is decent rather than poor, but it can become an issue if you constantly make him press, sprint and make repeated attacking runs.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Dalglish looks like an extremely reliable and dangerous ST, especially for players who value consistent finishing and finesse shots.

reviews.name: Vincent Kompany
reviews.pros:
Kompany has excellent pace for a centre-back. 

* His reactions are excellent and very important for a CB. 

* This is arguably his biggest strength. Kompany is extremely reliable with his tackling, interceptions and defensive positioning. 

* His physicality makes him a nightmare for opposing attackers. 

* The Lvl 2 Bruiser playstyle further enhances his ability to use his strength aggressively, helping him win physical battles and dispossess attackers without being easily pushed off the ball. 

* Lvl 1 Precision Header, this is a very useful addition for a tall CB like Kompany. 

* Good stamina is a major advantage for a CB. 

* Dives into tackles, this trait fits his aggressive defensive profile perfectly.
reviews.cons: None.
reviews.verdict: Kompany is an absolute monster at CB. He combines pace, elite defending, excellent reactions, physical dominance, stamina and very useful defensive traits. The fact that he has no noticeable cons makes his card even more impressive. A complete, aggressive and highly reliable CB who looks like an endgame-level option.

reviews.name: Blaise Matuidi
reviews.pros:
Blaise Matuidi's defensive work rate makes him very effective at winning the ball and disrupting opposition attacks. 

* His 5-star stamina allows him to stay active throughout the match and consistently cover large areas of midfield. 

* His dribbling makes him comfortable in possession and helps him move the ball out of pressure. 

* His physicality helps him compete strongly in midfield duels and win challenges. 

* His pace allows him to cover ground quickly and recover when opponents break forward. 

* His passing is reliable for keeping possession and moving the ball quickly in midfield. 

* His positioning helps him cover spaces effectively and provide defensive support in front of the back line. 

* His Bruiser PlayStyle increases his strength during physical battles, making him even more effective when challenging for the ball.
reviews.cons:
His 2-star skill moves limit his ability to create space and beat opponents in tight situations. 

* His 3-star weak foot can affect his consistency when passing or shooting with his weaker foot.
reviews.verdict: Blaise Matuidi is a hardworking and defensively focused CDM who offers excellent stamina, physicality, pace, and reliable dribbling. His 5-star stamina allows him to remain heavily involved throughout the match, while his Bruiser PlayStyle further improves his effectiveness in physical battles. Although his 2-star skill moves and 3-star weak foot are noticeable limitations, his defensive qualities, mobility, and work rate make him a strong option for a defensive-minded midfield setup.

reviews.name: Ferenc Puskas
reviews.pros:
He gets into attacking positions quickly and is excellent at exploiting gaps behind the defence. 

* Particularly good for joystick players who like to turn, shift direction and create their own shooting angle. 

* His ability to combine quick touches with sudden shots makes him difficult for defenders to read. 

* When you get him onto his preferred foot, the finishing becomes genuinely scary.
reviews.cons:
Getting him onto the preferred foot can make a noticeable difference to the quality of chances. 

* Finishing from awkward angles isn't always as convincing as his ideal shooting positions. 

* Can disappear for periods if your opponent completely blocks the central attacking lanes.
reviews.verdict:
He's not the striker you buy to bully defenders or win every shoulder-to-shoulder battle. You buy him because one touch, one turn and one opening can completely change the game.
For players who enjoy dribbling into shooting positions and taking aggressive chances around the box, he's incredibly fun. But against physical, high-level defenders, you need to play to his strengths rather than forcing him into battles.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Brahim
reviews.pros:
Once he gets into space, he can turn a simple counter into a genuine scoring opportunity. 

* His small, agile build makes quick turns and tight dribbles feel very natural. 

* You don't have to treat him as just a provider; he can absolutely punish defenders himself. 

* With his ability to use either foot, defenders can't simply force him onto one side. 

* Quick passing combinations around the box are where Brahim becomes particularly dangerous.
reviews.cons:
His impact can noticeably drop later in matches, especially if you're constantly using him to sprint and press. 

* Don't expect him to win many shoulder-to-shoulder situations or dominate defensively. 

* Small frame can occasionally work against him when facing stronger defenders or competing for aerial balls.
reviews.verdict:
He's not the RM you pick because you want someone to dominate physically or defend for 90 minutes. You pick him because you want to break defensive structures. One quick turn, one burst of acceleration and suddenly the full-back is chasing shadows. 

* For H2H players who love fast transitions, skill moves and aggressive attacking, this is a seriously fun card. The only thing stopping him from pushing into the 9+ territory is that physical/defensive limitation.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Ludovic Giuly
reviews.pros:
Probably his biggest in-game attraction. Tight turns and quick skill moves feel smooth rather than heavy. 

* He's not just a creator; once he gets into the box, he can actually finish the move. 

* Makes intelligent runs into space instead of constantly waiting for the ball. 

* Ideal for players who like taking on full-backs rather than simply passing around them. 

* He can stretch the pitch or drift inside and essentially become another attacking player.
reviews.cons:
Stronger full-backs can knock him off the ball if you hold possession too long. 

* He's much more interested in attacking than tracking runners. 

* If you prefer crossing and physical wide midfielders, he won't feel as effective.
reviews.verdict:
He's not the RM you pick because you want someone to dominate physically or defend for 90 minutes. You pick him because you want to break defensive structures. One quick turn, one burst of acceleration and suddenly the full-back is chasing shadows. 

* For H2H players who love fast transitions, skill moves and aggressive attacking, this is a seriously fun card. The only thing stopping him from pushing into the 9+ territory is that physical/defensive limitation.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Matvey Safonov
reviews.pros:
His reflexes are a major strength. They should allow him to react quickly to close-range attempts and make difficult saves when attackers get into dangerous positions. 

* His diving is also strong, making him reliable when dealing with shots aimed toward the corners. 

* His handling is solid, helping him deal with shots more cleanly and reducing the chances of easy rebounds. 

* His kicking and long passing are useful for starting counterattacks from the back, particularly if you like building quickly after winning possession. 

* His 6'4" height combined with his physical strength makes him a good option for players who prefer a taller goalkeeper.
reviews.cons:
His positioning can be a weakness compared with the very best endgame goalkeepers. This can occasionally lead to him being slightly out of position against well-placed shots. 

* His 2 star weak foot is a limitation when trying to distribute the ball under pressure, especially when opponents aggressively press the goalkeeper. 

* There are stronger goalkeeper options available at the highest ratings, so Safonov may not be the best choice if you are looking for the absolute top-tier GK.
reviews.verdict: Safonov is a very solid 119 OVR goalkeeper who offers a good combination of height, reflexes, diving, handling and physical presence. His biggest advantage is his 6'4" frame combined with strong reflexes and diving. However, his positioning, jumping and weak-foot limitations prevent him from being a truly elite goalkeeper. Overall, Safonov is a dependable goalkeeper and a good option if you already have him ranked and trained. He is especially appealing for players who prefer tall goalkeepers with strong reflexes rather than relying purely on positioning.

reviews.name: Rodrygo
reviews.pros:
Rodrygo offers excellent pace, making him very effective at beating fullbacks and attacking space on the right wing. 

* His dribbling is a major strength. His agile build allows him to turn quickly, change direction and carry the ball effectively in tight areas. 

* His 4 star skill moves provide enough variety to perform useful attacking skills and create separation from defenders. 

* The 4 star weak foot is another advantage for a RW, allowing him to pass and finish comfortably with either foot. 

* Rodrygo has strong attacking movement and is well suited to making diagonal runs from the right and getting into dangerous positions around the box. 

* His Finesse Shot trait is particularly useful when cutting inside from the right and attempting curled finishes towards the far corner. 

* He can also play ST, providing useful positional flexibility and allowing him to be moved centrally during matches.
reviews.cons:
His height and build also make him a limited aerial threat. Against very physical defenders, Rodrygo can sometimes struggle despite his pace and agility. 

* There are also better options available at this rating range if your priority is maximum physicality, 5 star skill moves or an elite all-round RW.
reviews.verdict: Rodrygo is a very enjoyable RW for players who prefer a quick, agile and technically capable winger. His attributes make him particularly dangerous when cutting inside from the right. He can beat defenders on the outside, cut inside onto his stronger foot or use his weak foot when necessary. Overall, Rodrygo is a strong attacking winger who excels through pace, agility and finesse finishing rather than physicality.

reviews.name: Alvaro Carreras
reviews.pros:
Álvaro Carreras's pace is very good, allowing him to keep up with fast wingers and recover quickly. 

* His dribbling makes him comfortable when carrying the ball forward and helps him escape pressure on the flank. 

* His passing allows him to link up well with teammates and build attacks from the right side. 

* His crossing is a strong part of his attacking game, especially when delivering from wide areas. 

* His physicality gives him enough strength to compete in defensive duels. 

* His defensive awareness helps him track runners and deal with attacking threats consistently. 

* His Whipped Cross PlayStyle gives lob crosses increased accuracy and curve, while also reducing errors when taking corner kicks.
reviews.cons:
His defensive positioning can sometimes leave space behind when he pushes forward. 

* His 3-star skill moves limit his ability to perform advanced dribbling techniques, especially if you like to use your full-backs aggressively in attack.
reviews.verdict: Álvaro Carreras is a well-rounded right-back who offers good pace, strong dribbling, reliable passing, and useful physicality. His ability to carry the ball and contribute to build-up play makes him effective going forward, while his Whipped Cross PlayStyle adds extra quality to his deliveries and corners. Although his defensive positioning and limited skill moves is noticeable drawbacks, he remains a strong and dependable option at right-back.

reviews.name: Desire Doue
reviews.pros:
Désiré Doué's dribbling is very effective, allowing him to beat defenders and create space in one-on-one situations. 

* His pace allows him to quickly burst away from defenders and exploit open spaces. 

* His agility and close control make him difficult to dispossess in tight areas. 

* His ball carrying allows him to progress quickly down the right flank and transition into attack. 

* His 5-star skill moves give him more options to beat defenders and create space in the final third. 

* His Accelerator PlayStyle improves his acceleration without the ball, making his attacking runs more effective.
reviews.cons:
His physicality can sometimes be an issue against stronger defenders. 

* He has no traits, which slightly limits his overall gameplay variety. 

* His 4-star weak foot can occasionally affect his consistency when finishing or passing on his weaker side.
reviews.verdict: Désiré Doué is a highly agile and explosive winger who offers excellent dribbling, pace, and close control. His 5-star skill moves make him particularly dangerous in one-on-one situations, while the Accelerator PlayStyle adds extra value to his movement without the ball. His 4-star weak foot gives him good versatility, especially when playing on the LW. However, his physicality, lack of traits, and weaker-foot consistency are noticeable limitations. With LW as his alternative position, he remains a strong attacking option for players who enjoy direct and skilful wingers.

reviews.name: Eder Militao
reviews.pros:
Éder Militão's defending is very reliable, making him effective in one-on-one situations and defensive transitions. 

* His pace allows him to recover quickly when attackers get in behind. 

* His physicality helps him handle strong forwards and compete well in physical duels. 

* His reactions and defensive awareness allow him to respond quickly to dangerous situations. 

* His tackling is consistent, helping him win the ball cleanly and stop attacking moves. 

* His Anticipate PlayStyle improves his standing tackle range and speed, making his defensive challenges more effective.
reviews.cons:
His passing can feel less consistent when attempting more difficult passes from the back. 

* His dribbling can feel slightly heavy when carrying the ball under pressure.
reviews.verdict: Éder Militão is a strong and reliable centre-back who combines pace, physicality, and solid defensive ability. His recovery speed is particularly valuable against fast attackers, while the Anticipate PlayStyle further improves his ability to win the ball through standing tackles. Although his passing and dribbling have some limitations,he remains a very dependable CB for players who value pace and defensive stability.

reviews.name: Thibaut Courtois
reviews.pros:
The biggest W is his overall presence in goal. Courtois feels huge and covers a lot of the goal, especially in close range situations. 

* Reflexes are really reliable. He makes some quick saves that you wouldn't expect, especially when shots are taken from inside the box. 

* Positioning is another strong point. He generally stays in good positions and doesn't leave too much space for attackers to target. 

* His height makes a noticeable difference. High shots and difficult angles are much easier for him to deal with compared to shorter keepers. 

* Surprisingly, he feels more consistent against finesse shots than some other top GKs, even with only Level 1 Deflector. 

* Deflector is a very useful playstyle. His saves often push the ball into safer areas instead of giving attackers an easy rebound. 

* Handling feels solid too. He doesn't constantly spill easy shots and usually keeps control when dealing with regular attempts. 

* Very good in 1v1 situations. His size makes it difficult for attackers to find a clean finish when they get through. 

* At only 18,630 shards, he's honestly a steal for the level of performance you're getting.
reviews.cons:
The biggest downside is that he doesn't have Level 2 Deflector. That's probably the only major thing missing from this card. 

* There is still a bit of inconsistency in his gameplay right now. But with the buff, we'll see if we get the Courtois we're used to again.
reviews.verdict:
Courtois already feels like a top tier GK despite a few inconsistencies. His size, positioning, reflexes and surprisingly good performance against finesse shots make him really reliable. 

* The price makes it even better. 18,630 shards for this card is a steal.

reviews.name: Kaka
reviews.pros:
Kaká feels really quick on the ball and can easily burst past defenders, especially when attacking open space. 

* 5 star skill move + 5 star weak foot is a huge advantage. He feels smooth on both feet and gives you a lot of freedom when creating chances. 

* The Level 2 Finesse Expert is absolutely insane. His finesse shots feel very accurate and dangerous from outside the box. 

* His shooting is excellent overall. He can finish chances inside the box while also being a serious threat from long range. 

* Dribbling feels elite. He's very smooth and responsive when turning, carrying the ball and taking on defenders. 

* His passing is also very reliable. He can play quick combinations around the box and consistently find teammates with through balls. 

* The Level 1 Rapid playstyle is a nice bonus and makes his acceleration even more explosive when sprint dribbling. 

* 5 star Stamina is another big W. He can stay involved throughout the match without becoming a problem late in the game. 

* His High attacking work rate suits the CAM position perfectly. He constantly looks to get forward and make attacking runs. 

* He feels very good in the final third. The combination of pace, dribbling, shooting and finesse makes him a constant threat around the box.
reviews.cons: No significant weekness.
reviews.verdict: Kaká feels like a complete attacking CAM. The pace, dribbling, 5 star/5 star, shooting and Level 2 Finesse Expert all come together perfectly. He's extremely smooth on the ball, dangerous from range and can create or finish chances consistently.

reviews.name: Toni Kroos
reviews.pros:
Passing is easily the biggest W. Kroos feels incredibly clean on the ball and his passes come out quick, accurate and exactly where you want them. 
* Tiki Taka makes his short passing even better. Quick combinations feel really smooth and he rarely messes up simple passes under pressure. 
* Finesse Expert is a really nice addition. When you get the space to shoot, his finesse shots feel much more dangerous and consistent. 
* His long passing is excellent. Switching play or finding a runner from deep feels effortless, which makes him perfect for controlling the tempo. 
* Very smooth on the ball. He turns nicely, keeps the ball close and doesn't feel heavy when moving through midfield. 
* 5 star weak foot is a huge plus. You can pass and shoot comfortably from either side without constantly worrying about which foot he's going to use. 
* High attacking work rate keeps him involved. He naturally pushes forward and gives you another option around the box. 
* Long shots are another big strength. Give him some space outside the box and he's definitely capable of making the keeper work. 
* Good movement in midfield. He finds useful positions and is always available as a passing option. 
* Having CAM and CDM as alt positions is a massive bonus. You can fit Kroos into different formations and move him around your midfield depending on how you want to play.
reviews.cons:
Physicality can be an issue against stronger midfielders. He can get pushed around when the game becomes too physical. 
* Defensively he's more of a positional midfielder than someone you want constantly winning duels. 
* 4 star skill moves are fine, but 5 star would have made him even more complete in tight areas.
reviews.verdict:
Kroos is a proper midfield controller. His passing, ball control and shooting make him incredibly enjoyable to use, especially if you like building attacks through the middle. 

* Tiki Taka and Finesse Expert complement his gameplay really well and make him feel like a genuine playmaker. 

* The CAM and CDM versatility is another big W, especially if you switch formations often.

reviews.name: Kvicha Kvaratskhelia
reviews.pros:
Very fast and explosive, making him extremely dangerous on the wing. 

* Trickster Lv.1 is surprisingly effective, making his skill moves feel smooth, quick, and very difficult to defend against. 

* Tiki Taka Lv.1 improves his short passing and helps in build-up play and quick combinations. 

* 5 star weak foot is a huge advantage, making his shooting and passing reliable on both sides. 

* Finishing is excellent, while his long-range shooting is particularly dangerous. 

* Finesse Shot and Long Shot Taker traits make him a constant threat from different areas. 

* Good physicality and his 6'0 height give him a well-balanced structure. 

* Can also play as RW and performs brilliantly there.
reviews.cons:
The playstyles feel slightly underwhelming for a card of this level. Rapid or a finishing-focused playstyle would have made him much more dominant. 

* His previous versions somehow felt a little more dominant, so a slight gameplay buff would have made this card more special.
reviews.verdict: An excellent winger with elite pace, smooth skill moves, 5 star weak foot, and dangerous shooting from almost anywhere. He's still a top-tier option, but the Level 1 playstyles don't make him feel quite as special as expected.

reviews.name: Raul
reviews.pros:
Clinical Finisher playstyle makes his finishing extremely reliable and improves the accuracy and speed of his shots. 

* Finishing is excellent, especially inside the box, and he can convert chances consistently. 

* Finesse Shot and Outside Foot Shot traits make him dangerous from different angles and give him more shooting options. 

* Pace is very good, allowing him to make sharp attacking runs and get behind defenders. 

* Dribbling and ball control are smooth, making him comfortable in tight spaces. 

* Passing is solid for a striker and helps him link up effectively with teammates. 

* Flair trait adds extra creativity to his attacking play. 

* 5'11 height gives him a balanced build with enough physicality to handle most situations.
reviews.cons: 4 star weak foot is reliable, but a 5 star weak foot would have made him even more complete.
reviews.verdict: A very complete and clinical striker with excellent finishing, smooth movement, and multiple shooting options. Clinical Finisher combined with Finesse Shot and Outside Foot Shot makes Raúl a highly reliable ST.

reviews.name: Gareth Bale
reviews.pros:
Insane pace with Rapid playstyle, making him extremely dangerous on counters and attacking runs. 

* Solid physicality allows him to carry the ball at high speed without getting pushed off easily. 

* Dribbling and ball control are excellent, with good agility and smooth movement. 

* Shooting and finishing are top-tier, making him a constant goal threat. 

* Weak-foot finishing is also very reliable, especially in close and mid-range situations. 

* Passing and crossing are excellent, making him effective in build-up and wide attacks. 

* Clinical Finisher playstyle gives his finishing an extra boost and makes his regular shots even more dangerous. 

* Finesse Shot and Long Shot Taker traits add more variety to his shooting. 

* Can also play as ST and RW, giving him excellent versatility.
reviews.cons:
Weak-foot long shots can still be inconsistent despite his otherwise reliable weak foot. 

* Requires around 67,000 shards, which is extremely expensive and makes him difficult for most F2P players to obtain.
reviews.verdict: An explosive and complete attacker with elite pace, shooting, finishing, and physicality. Rapid and Clinical Finisher make him incredibly dangerous, with the huge shard requirement being his biggest drawback.

reviews.name: Joao Neves
reviews.pros:
João Neves offers a balanced combination of passing, dribbling, defending and work rate, making him effective in multiple midfield roles. 

* High/High work rate keeps him heavily involved in both attack and defence. He constantly looks to support teammates and contribute during transitions. 

* The tiki taka PlayStyle improves short passing and makes him effective in quick combinations. 

* His compact build and dribbling potential help him carry the ball through midfield and handle pressure reasonably well. 

* The 4 star weak foot is very useful for a central midfielder, allowing him to pass and control the ball comfortably from either side.
reviews.cons:
3 star skill rating limits his ability to use advanced skill moves and beat opponents individually. 

* His work rate can sometimes see him push too far forward when you want him to maintain his defensive position. 

* At 5'9" and 66 kg, he can struggle against stronger and more physical midfielders. His height makes him less effective when competing for headers.
reviews.verdict: João Neves is an excellent box-to-box CM for players who value mobility, passing and constant involvement. His attributes make him particularly effective in possession-based systems. He is not the ideal choice if you want a physically dominant CDM or an attacking midfielder focused on scoring. Overall, he is a highly versatile CM who can contribute to build-up, pressing, defending and transitions. His ability to also play CDM and RB adds further value.

reviews.name: Claude Makelele
reviews.pros:
His Anticipate PlayStyle improves stand-tackle proficiency and success rate, making Makélélé particularly effective at stepping in and winning the ball cleanly. 

* For a CDM who frequently receives the ball under pressure, the tiki taka playstyle makes Makélélé more reliable when recycling possession and playing short combinations. 

* The Long Passer trait adds another dimension to his distribution. He isn't simply a destroyer; he can also help initiate attacks from deep. 

* With Low/High work rate he naturally prioritises defensive duties and is less likely to abandon his position unnecessarily. 

* Dives Into Tackles and Acrobatic Clearance complement his defensive role, while Anticipate makes him even more suited to aggressive ball recovery.
reviews.cons:
Makélélé has only 3-star skill moves, so he isn't the type of CDM you should rely on for elaborate skill combinations when escaping pressure. 

* His 3-star weak foot can occasionally become noticeable when he receives the ball on his weaker side, particularly under heavy pressure. 

* At 5'9" (174 cm), Makélélé lacks the height and reach of taller defensive midfielders. This can make aerial contests and some physical duels more difficult against bigger opponents.
reviews.verdict: Claude Makélélé is an outstanding specialist CDM and one of the most naturally defensive midfielders you can use. His attributes are particularly attractive for players who want their CDM to stay back, win possession and distribute the ball efficiently. If you want a disciplined midfield anchor who stays in position, wins tackles and keeps possession moving, Makélélé is an excellent choice.

reviews.name: Malo Gusto
reviews.pros:
He has enough speed to stay with quick wingers, make recovery runs and cover the space behind him when he pushes forward. 

* The Lvl 1 Accelerator is an especially good addition because it makes him accelerate faster without the ball, which is extremely useful for a fullback tracking an opponent or recovering into position. 

* Good reactions make Gusto feel responsive when defending. 

* Gusto isn't simply an attacking fullback with decent defensive stats, he has the defensive ability to genuinely hold his own against opposing wingers. 

* Good physicality is a very useful advantage for Gusto. 

* This is an excellent work-rate combination for an attacking-minded fullback. High attacking work rate encourages Gusto to get forward and provide width, while High defensive work rate helps him track back and participate defensively. 

* Dives into tackles trait, this gives him another defensive edge. Gusto is more willing to commit to tackles and can be aggressive when trying to win the ball.
reviews.cons: This is the main weakness of the card. Three-star skill moves limit Gusto's ability to use advanced skill moves when he's attacking down the right flank.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Gusto is a very dependable RB for H2H: fast enough to handle wingers, physical enough to compete, defensively strong and active at both ends of the pitch. He's not the most technically gifted attacking fullback, but if your priority is a complete, aggressive and reliable RB, this is a very good 124 OVR option.

reviews.name: Marcelo
reviews.pros:
For a fullback, Marcelo has decent pace, which is important because the LB position requires constant movement up and down the flank. 

* Marcelo is much more than a defensive fullback when it comes to creating chances. 

* Lvl 1 Whipped Cross is particularly suitable for a fullback because it makes crosses faster while improving their accuracy and curve. 

* Good reactions are important for a fullback because they constantly have to respond to changes in possession. 

* This is one of Marcelo's biggest advantages. A 5 star skill-move rating gives him access to the full range of skill moves and makes him much more dangerous when carrying the ball forward. 

* Despite his attacking qualities, his defending is good enough to make him a legitimate LB. 

* Excellent stamina is important for Marcelo because his game involves a lot of movement.
reviews.cons:
This is probably Marcelo's biggest actual gameplay weakness. His physicality isn't particularly impressive, so he can struggle when directly battling strong wingers or forwards. 

* This is an important limitation of the current skill-point system. Cards below 120 OVR don't receive the same stat benefit from the skill points allotted to them compared to the ones 120 and above.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Marcelo is a great choice for players who want an attacking LB with excellent technical ability. He's not the most physically dominant or defensively imposing fullback, but his 5 star skills, stamina and playmaking make him a very enjoyable and versatile option.

reviews.name: Federico Valverde
reviews.pros:
Valverde's pace is one of the biggest reasons this card stands out. Having that kind of speed on a CM is already excellent, but the fact that he can also play CDM and RB makes it even more valuable. 

* His Lvl 1 Accelerator further complements this profile by giving his burst-speed situations more value. 

* Valverde isn't a midfielder you should be afraid to shoot with. 

* His passing gives him the ability to function as the link between your defence and attack. 

* Good reactions are extremely valuable on a box-to-box midfielder. 

* This is one of the reasons Valverde works so well as a CM/CDM hybrid. He isn't merely an attacking midfielder with pace; he has the defensive ability to win the ball and contribute meaningfully when your team is out of possession. 

* His physicality makes him much more dependable in midfield battles. 

* His stamina allows him to keep contributing throughout the match rather than becoming ineffective late on.
reviews.cons:
This is noticeable when you're trying to play quickly under pressure. A 4 star weak foot is still perfectly usable, but it means Valverde isn't quite as reliable as a midfielder with 5 star weak foot when passing or shooting from awkward angles. 

* This is probably the bigger attacking limitation. Three-star skills restrict the variety of skill moves available to him and make him less suited to players who like to beat defenders with elaborate skill combinations.
reviews.verdict: Overall, Valverde is an ideal choice if you want a tireless, fast and complete box-to-box midfielder who contributes everywhere rather than specializing in just one area.

reviews.name: Marquinhos
reviews.pros:
For a CB, Marquinhos' pace is a major advantage. 

* This is another big strength. Marquinhos isn't just a defender who wins the ball and immediately gives it away; he can actually help you build from the back. 

* The Bullet Pass playstyle makes his driven ground passes faster and more accurate, which is excellent for quickly finding your CDM or midfielders after winning possession. 

* His reactions complement his defensive stats nicely. 

* This is obviously one of his biggest selling points. His defending allows him to compete effectively in tackles, interceptions and general defensive situations. 

* His physicality gives him enough strength to handle attackers and compete in shoulder-to-shoulder situations.
reviews.cons:
This is probably the biggest issue with the card. Guardian isn't useless, it improves hard-tackle range, speed and the ability to stop the ball at the defender's feet but it is more dependent on actively using hard tackles. 

* For a CB, Anticipate would arguably be the better option, because standing tackles are much more commonly used when defending attackers directly. 

* Bruiser would also have been excellent because it directly boosts strength during physical battles. 

* This is the other noticeable weakness. At 183 cm, Marquinhos is on the shorter side for a CB.
reviews.verdict: Overall, he's an excellent all-round CB and a very strong option for H2H, but his playstyle and height keep him just short of the absolute top-tier CB category.

reviews.name: Manuel Locatelli
reviews.pros:
Reads the game well and is good at cutting passing lanes. 

* Doesn't get easily bullied when fighting for possession. 

* Once he wins the ball, he can quickly turn defence into attack. 

* Naturally finds useful defensive positions instead of constantly chasing the ball.
reviews.cons:
Not explosive enough when you need your CDM to instantly close down a dangerous player. 

* Turning can feel less responsive compared with more agile meta midfielders, especially under heavy pressure. 

* Lacks that elite “presence” you get from the best CDMs; he can feel ordinary against top-tier opponents. 

* Against extremely aggressive or physical midfielders, he may struggle to completely dominate the battle. 

* Not the most dynamic option if your playstyle involves constantly switching direction and carrying the ball through midfield.
reviews.verdict: Locatelli is a solid and dependable CDM, but he doesn't quite have the impact you'd expect from a top-tier 119 OVR midfielder. He reads the game well, protects the defence and keeps possession moving, making him a useful option for a controlled H2H playstyle. However, when the match gets intense, his lack of explosiveness and attacking threat becomes noticeable. He can do almost everything reasonably well, but nothing feels truly elite.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Mario Mandzukic
reviews.pros:
Defenders can struggle to push him off the ball, especially when he gets his body between them and the goal. 

* Give him a proper chance and he's capable of putting it away with authority. 

* Crosses, cutbacks and physical battles around the box are where he becomes particularly annoying to defend.
reviews.cons:
His 3 star Skill move is the biggest issue for H2H players who rely heavily on skill moves. Don't expect him to perform the same quick combinations as 4 star or 5 star STs. 

* He can feel a little heavy when you're trying to turn quickly under pressure. 

* Even though he can make runs, he doesn't always explode away from defenders like the fastest meta forwards. 

* He's much better at finishing the move than creating something out of absolutely nothing. 

* If your playstyle revolves around rapid turns, close control and constant skill-move spam, Mandžukić may feel restrictive.
reviews.verdict:
Mandžukić is a specialist, not a universal striker.
If you play crosses, through balls, hold-up play and physical football, he can be seriously effective. But if your idea of a perfect ST is someone who can turn instantly, spam skill moves and glide past defenders, the 3 star skill moves and heavier feel become difficult to ignore. He's not the Ferrari of FC Mobile strikers, he's the tank.  Point him toward the goal, give him service, and let the physicality do the talking.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Jonathan David
reviews.pros:
Excellent for running in behind and punishing high defensive lines. 

* Turns sharply and feels comfortable changing direction under pressure. 

* Often finds useful pockets of space rather than standing around waiting for the ball.
reviews.cons:
Don't expect him to dominate against huge, physical CBs. 

* Aerial presence isn't his biggest strength, so crossing-heavy gameplay isn't where he looks most dangerous. 

* Can feel less effective when the opponent sits deep and gives him absolutely no space to attack. 

* Against elite physical defenders, he can sometimes struggle to hold his ground and maintain possession.
reviews.verdict: Jonathan David is a speed-first assassin, not a tank. His game is about movement, acceleration, quick turns and getting into scoring positions before the defence can react. If your gameplay is built around through balls, quick combinations and counter-attacks, he'll be genuinely dangerous. But if you want an ST who can simply stand between two CBs, win every physical battle and dominate crosses, there are better options.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Bremer
reviews.pros:
A decent and reliable centre-back with good overall defensive ability. 

* Tackling is solid, and he performs well in physical duels. 

* Good height and physicality give him a strong presence against attackers. 

* Man marking is excellent, helping him stay tight to strikers and track runs effectively. 

* Positioning is decent, while his pace allows him to recover against faster attackers. 

* Long Passer trait is useful for starting counters and quick attacks from the back.
reviews.cons:
Guardian playstyle isn't particularly impactful and mainly helps in specific hard-tackle situations. 

* Anticipate, Accelerator, or Bruiser would have made him much more dominant and consistent. 

* Doesn't have many standout defensive traits, making him feel less unique. 

* There are already several much better CB options available at this level.
reviews.verdict: A solid CB with good physicality, marking, pace, and tackling, but nothing really stands out. The lack of stronger defensive playstyles and traits makes him difficult to recommend over the better options available.

reviews.name: Kenan Yildiz
reviews.pros:
A very good CAM option with excellent all-round attacking ability. 

* Trickster playstyle makes his skill moves more effective and helps him beat defenders in 1v1 situations. 

* 5 star weak foot is a huge advantage, making his shooting and passing reliable on both sides. 

* Dribbling and ball control are excellent, feeling smooth and controlled on the ball. 

* Very good pace with quick movement and attacking runs. 

* Shooting and finishing are both excellent, making him a consistent goal threat. 

* Passing and overall ball distribution are brilliant, helping a lot in build-up and chance creation. 

* His 6'1 height and good physicality give him a strong and balanced structure. 

* Can also play as LM and LW, performing brilliantly in both positions.
reviews.cons:
4 star stamina is acceptable, but he can sometimes lose stamina quickly and become less effective late in matches. 

* Doesn't have any special traits, which makes the card feel slightly less unique compared to other top attackers.
reviews.verdict: A smooth and versatile attacking midfielder with excellent dribbling, shooting, passing, and a perfect weak foot. Trickster adds extra creativity, while his versatility makes him useful across several attacking positions.

reviews.name: Miroslav Klose
reviews.pros:
Miroslav Klose's movement is very good, helping him make well-timed runs and find space in dangerous areas. 

* His pace is very good for a target forward, allowing him to make effective runs behind the defence. 

* His aerial ability makes him a constant threat when attacking crosses. 

* His finishing is reliable, especially when he gets clear chances around the goal. 

* His physical presence allows him to compete well with defenders and hold his position during challenges. 

* His Precision Header PlayStyle makes header shots, passes, and clearances slightly faster and more accurate, further improving his aerial game.
reviews.cons:
His dribbling is not as smooth when turning against defenders in tight spaces. 

* His passing is decent but not as consistent as the better all-round forwards. 

* His 3-star skill moves limit his ability to create space through skill moves. 

* His turning can feel slightly heavy when quickly changing direction.
reviews.verdict: Miroslav Klose is a classic Target Forward who relies on positioning, finishing, physicality, and aerial ability. His pace is also very good for this type of striker, while the Precision Header PlayStyle makes him particularly effective when attacking crosses. He may lack the technical fluidity of more agile forwards, but his strong box presence and aerial threat make him a solid choice for players who prefer a traditional target striker.

reviews.name: Manuel Neuer
reviews.pros:
Reflexes feel really good. He reacts quickly to shots and can pull off some very solid saves, especially in close range situations. 

* Positioning is one of his better qualities. He generally gets himself into good spots and doesn't feel completely lost when facing attacks. 

* Diving is quite good. When he gets across to the ball, his reach and reactions can make a real difference. 

* Bullet Pass is actually a fun addition. His passes travel really quickly over distance, making it easy to start quick counters or find players in open space. 

* Good value for the price. At just 3.2K Shards, he's a pretty cheap option if you need a usable GK without spending a ton.
reviews.cons:
No proper GK Playstyle is a big downside. This is probably the biggest issue with the card and holds him back compared to stronger goalkeeper options. 

* Very inconsistent at times. He can make some really good saves but then concede shots you wouldn't expect him to, so he doesn't always give that elite GK feeling you'd expect from Neuer.
reviews.verdict: Neuer is decent for the price, with good reflexes, positioning and diving. Bullet Pass is a nice bonus too, but his inconsistency and lack of a GK Playstyle stop him from being a top tier option.

reviews.name: Harry Kane
reviews.pros:
Kane's pace is actually respectable for his profile. He's obviously not the type of striker you use purely for explosive runs behind the defence, but he has enough speed to make useful attacking runs and keep up with the play. 

* This is easily one of Kane's biggest strengths. A striker's primary job is to finish chances, and Kane delivers in that department. 

* While Clinical Finisher further complements his ability to convert opportunities. 

* Considering Kane's size and traditional striker profile, being decently smooth is a nice bonus. He won't feel like an extremely agile dribbler, but he has enough ball control and responsiveness to link up with teammates and work his way into shooting positions. 

* His physicality fits his striker profile perfectly.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot is probably the most noticeable gameplay limitation. For a striker, having 5 star weak foot is extremely valuable because chances can arrive from either side and you don't always have time to adjust your body. 

* Stamina is another weakness that can become noticeable over the course of a match. 

* This is a particularly unfortunate aspect of the card. Because his OVR is below 120, his skill-point progression is restricted compared with higher-rated cards. That means you're not getting as much potential from his skill-point setup as you otherwise could.
reviews.verdict: Kane is a very solid traditional striker with good shooting, physicality, decent pace and surprisingly decent smoothness. His biggest problems are the 4 star weak foot, stamina and restricted skill-point potential.

reviews.name: Khephren Thuram
reviews.pros:
The pace is a major advantage for Thuram. At CDM, having good speed allows him to cover large areas of the midfield, track attacking midfielders and recover quickly when possession is lost. 

* Thuram isn't just a defensive midfielder who wins the ball and immediately looks for the safest pass. 

* His reactions are good enough to make him reasonably responsive when defending. 

* His defending is another major reason to use him at CDM. Thuram has the defensive tools to protect the back line, win challenges and disrupt opposition attacks. 

* This is arguably one of the most exciting aspects of the card. Thuram's physicality gives him a significant advantage in midfield battles, allowing him to compete with strong opponents and hold his ground. 

* Bruiser further complements this by making his physical defending more aggressive and effective. 

* The 6'4" height is a massive advantage for a CDM. Thuram has the physical presence that many midfielders simply don't have.
reviews.cons:
This is the main concern with the card. High/High isn't necessarily bad, but it isn't the ideal work-rate combination for a dedicated CDM like Thuram. 

* Medium/High would've been much better suited to his profile. With Medium attacking and High defensive work rates, Thuram would naturally prioritize maintaining his defensive position while still contributing when needed.
reviews.verdict: Thuram is a very strong physical CDM with an excellent combination of pace, defending, physicality and 6'4" height. His only real issue is the High/High work rate, which isn't ideal for a defensive midfielder and can occasionally pull him out of position.

reviews.name: Claudio Pizarro
reviews.pros:
For a striker like Pizarro, the pace is acceptable but nothing special. The pace is good enough for a more traditional striker who focuses on positioning, finishing and holding the ball up. 

* This is easily his biggest strength. Pizarro's finishing is what makes the card usable despite some of his physical limitations. 

* While Finesse Expert gives him an additional weapon for curling shots into the corners. 

* Good physicality suits Pizarro's striker profile.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot is noticeable for a striker, especially when you're expecting him to finish chances from either side of the box. 

* This is probably the biggest gameplay issue with the card. The Target Forward skill point fits his physical, traditional striker profile, but it also contributes to the feeling that he's not particularly agile or explosive. 

* Stamina is another significant drawback. A striker with limited stamina can become noticeably less effective as the match progresses.
reviews.verdict: Pizarro is a very specialized striker. His great shooting, Finesse Expert and physicality make him dangerous inside the box, but his 4 star weak foot, sluggish Target Forward profile and poor stamina seriously limit his versatility.

reviews.name: Andrea Pirlo
reviews.pros:
Passing is absolutely elite. He can pick out almost any pass you want and makes building from midfield feel effortless 

* Feels super smooth on the ball and turns nicely under pressure 

* Tiki Taka + Bullet Pass is a massive W. His passes come out super quickly and feel incredibly clean, especially when you're trying to play through tight spaces. 

* Great positioning defensively with the High Defensive Work Rate 

* Long shots are a big threat, especially when you get space outside the box 

* 5 star Skill Moves gives him more options when escaping pressure via advanced SM 

* Very good stamina and can comfortably stay involved throughout the match 

* Play Maker and Long Shot Taker traits fit his gameplay perfectly.
reviews.cons:
Physicality can be an issue against stronger midfielders 

* Medium attacking work rate means he won't always make aggressive forward runs
reviews.verdict: Pirlo is an absolute midfield maestro. His passing, smooth movement and defensive presence make him incredibly reliable, and the playstyles take his passing game to another level. One of the best CM options if you like controlling the game.

reviews.name: Joshua Kimmich
reviews.pros:
Kimmich's pace is a major positive because CDMs don't always need to be lightning quick, but they absolutely need enough speed to cover space. 

* This is one of his biggest strengths. Kimmich is naturally suited to controlling the game from deep. 

* The Whipped Cross playstyle adds another dimension when switching play or delivering balls into dangerous areas from wider/deeper positions. 

* Excellent reactions are particularly valuable for a defensive midfielder. 

* His defensive ability makes him much more than just a passing midfielder. He can read situations, make interceptions and apply pressure effectively while sitting in front of the defence. 

* Good physical attributes are another important advantage. 

* This is arguably one of the most important positives on the card. CDMs cover huge amounts of ground, constantly moving between defence and attack. Relentless complements that perfectly, helping Kimmich maintain his work rate throughout the match. 

* This is an excellent work-rate combination for a CDM. Medium attacking work rate prevents him from constantly bombing forward, while High defensive work rate encourages him to stay involved defensively and return to his position.
reviews.cons: This is really the one obvious weakness. Kimmich's lack of height can become noticeable against taller midfielders, especially when competing for aerial balls, goal kicks and defensive headers.
reviews.verdict: Overall, he's a very complete CDM and should be especially strong for players who want a mobile, defensively reliable midfielder who can also dictate play from deep.

reviews.name: Francisco Conceicao
reviews.pros:
Francisco Conceição's pace is his biggest strength, making him extremely explosive and difficult for defenders to catch once he gets into space. 

* His dribbling allows him to beat defenders comfortably in one-on-one situations. 

* His agility and close control make him very effective in tight areas around the box. 

* His ball carrying allows him to progress quickly down the right side and create attacking opportunities. 

* His creativity and quick combinations make him useful when linking up with teammates in the final third. 

* His Accelerator PlayStyle helps him accelerate faster without the ball, making his off-the-ball runs even more dangerous.
reviews.cons:
His physicality can be an issue when facing stronger full-backs. 

* His finishing can be inconsistent when he gets into good scoring positions. 

* His crossing is not always reliable from wider areas. 

* His 3-star weak foot can affect his consistency when passing or shooting on his weaker side.
reviews.verdict: Francisco Conceição is an explosive and highly technical RM whose pace is his biggest advantage. His excellent dribbling, agility, and ball carrying make him dangerous in one-on-one situations, while the Accelerator PlayStyle further improves his off-the-ball movement. Although his physicality, finishing, crossing, and weak foot have some limitations, his elite pace and technical ability make him a strong option for players who prefer fast and direct wide players.

reviews.name: Weston Mckennie
reviews.pros:
Weston McKennie's pace gives him good mobility for a central midfielder, helping him cover ground and support transitions. 

* His physical presence helps him compete well in midfield duels. 

* His stamina is a useful asset, allowing him to stay involved for longer periods without dropping off too much. 

* His work rate makes him useful for covering space and supporting both phases of play. 

* His ability to play at CDM and CAM gives him useful positional versatility. 

* His Relentless PlayStyle reduces fatigue loss during play, helping him maintain his performance deeper into matches.
reviews.cons:
His dribbling can feel a little stiff when turning under pressure. 

* His passing is decent, but it lacks the accuracy and consistency of more technical midfielders. 

His shooting is inconsistent, especially from outside the box. 

* His 3-star weak foot can affect his consistency when passing or shooting with his weaker foot. 

* His 3-star skill moves limit his ability to create space and beat defenders in tight situations.
reviews.verdict: Weston McKennie is a versatile midfielder with good pace, physical presence, stamina, and positional flexibility. His profile suits CDM better than CM, where his physicality and work rate can be used more effectively. The Relentless PlayStyle also helps him maintain his performance throughout the match. However, his stiff dribbling, inconsistent shooting, and limited weak foot and skill moves keep him from being an elite midfield option. He works best as a functional CDM who can provide energy and physicality in midfield.

reviews.name: Philipp Lahm
reviews.pros:
Defending is ridiculously clean. He is always around the right position and his tackles feel very consistent. He rarely gives attackers an easy way through. 

* Anticipate LvL 2 is a massive W. His standing tackles feel sharp and reliable, especially when you step in at the right moment to win the ball. 

* Feels rapid in-game. Tracking back against fast wingers is never much of an issue and he recovers really well when caught out. 

* Very responsive and smooth. His reactions, agility and balance make him really easy to control in 1v1 situations. 

* Passing is genuinely one of his biggest strengths. He can comfortably play out from the back and his driven passes feel quick and accurate. 

* He doesn't feel clunky when turning or carrying the ball forward, which makes him much more enjoyable at both full-back and CDM. 

* H/H work rate suits him well. He's constantly involved and can contribute at both ends without feeling lazy. 

* Stamina is excellent. He can comfortably maintain his level throughout the entire match. 

* 4 star skill move is a nice bonus. Makes him more comfortable when moving forward and getting out of pressure. 

* Dives Into Tackles fits his gameplay perfectly. Adds more aggression and makes his defensive style feel even more active. 

* Long Passer is another useful trait. Switching play from deep feels very natural with him. 

* RB, LB and CDM versatility is a huge advantage. You can move him around depending on your squad and he still performs at a very high level.
reviews.cons: Aerial duels aren't his strongest area but not a major issue.
reviews.verdict: An absolute W at RB, LB and CDM. His defending, pace, responsiveness and passing make him incredibly reliable, while Anticipate Lv2 takes his tackling to another level.

reviews.name: Alphonso Davies
reviews.pros:
Alphonso Davies's pace is one of his standout qualities, allowing him to recover quickly and keep up with the fastest wingers. 

* His acceleration makes him extremely effective when chasing down attackers and making overlapping runs. 

* His dribbling and agility allow him to carry the ball forward comfortably and escape pressure. 

* His defensive awareness helps him stay composed in one-on-one situations and make timely challenges. 

* His Rapid PlayStyle provides faster acceleration while sprint dribbling, making his explosive movement even more noticeable in-game.
reviews.cons:
His defending is decent, but it can feel less reliable compared to the top defensive left-backs. 

* His physicality can occasionally be an issue when dealing with stronger and more physical attackers. 

* His crossing can be inconsistent when delivering from advanced wide areas.
reviews.verdict: Alphonso Alphonso Davies is a pace-focused left-back who offers excellent acceleration, recovery speed, and ball-carrying ability. His Rapid PlayStyle further enhances his explosive movement, making him very effective during quick transitions and overlapping runs. Although his defending, physicality, and crossing have some limitations compared to the top options, his speed and mobility make him a useful choice for players who prefer fast and aggressive full-backs.

reviews.name: Jamal Musiala
reviews.pros:
His acceleration and movement should be sufficient to find pockets of space, support the striker and make forward runs. 

* His shooting is a strong part of the card, particularly when you can set him up on his stronger foot. 

* Musiala's passing gives him another important dimension as a CAM. Lvl 1 Tiki Taka complements this style by making quick short passing combinations more effective, which is particularly useful when playing through crowded central areas. 

* This is arguably one of the most important characteristics of Musiala. His smoothness makes him enjoyable when carrying the ball. 

* This is a major advantage. Five-star skill moves give Musiala access to the full range of skill moves, which makes him much more unpredictable in one-on-one situations.
reviews.cons:
The 4-star weak foot is his main technical weakness. 

* Stamina is another concern. 

* This is probably the biggest issue when evaluating the card at this stage of the game. Because cards below 120 OVR have their skill points nerfed, the 124 OVR Musiala doesn't translate into the same level of statistical dominance that you'd expect from a top-end CAM. 

* His base qualities are good, but once you compare the actual in-game numbers against premium CAMs such as Del Piero, the difference becomes much more noticeable.
reviews.verdict: Musiala is a very enjoyable technical CAM, especially for players who value dribbling, skill moves and combination play. His smoothness, 5 star skills, shooting and Tiki Taka make him dangerous in attacking areas, but the 4 star weak foot, stamina and relatively underwhelming stats compared to top CAMs prevent him from being an elite option.

reviews.name: Mario Gomez
reviews.pros:
This is easily the biggest strength of the card. Gómez is built to be a proper finisher, and his shooting allows him to make the most of chances inside and around the box. 

* The physicality fits Gómez's striker profile perfectly.
reviews.cons:
A 4-star weak foot means his weaker-foot finishes and passes can be less reliable compared with strikers who have 5 star weak foot. 

* This is another significant limitation. Three-star skill moves give Gómez very little variety when trying to beat defenders himself. 

* The Target Forward skill point fits his physical striker profile, but it's not necessarily the most exciting choice for this card. 

* This is a particularly frustrating issue. Even if Gómez has reasonable overall pace, acceleration is what determines how quickly he gets moving from a standing or slow position. Without an acceleration boost, he can struggle to create that initial separation from centre-backs. 

* This ultimately ties several of the weaknesses together. Gómez's physical profile and striker archetype naturally make him less agile, but the sluggish feeling becomes more problematic when combined with limited acceleration and only 3 star skill moves.
reviews.verdict: Mario Gómez is a very traditional target-man striker. His shooting and physicality are excellent foundations, but the lack of acceleration, sluggish movement, 3 star skills and 4 star weak foot seriously limit his versatility.

reviews.name: Luis Diaz
reviews.pros:
Pace is one of Luis Díaz's biggest strengths. As a LW, having strong acceleration and overall speed is extremely important. 

* Lvl 1 Rapid makes him even more dangerous when given attacking space. 

* Díaz has good finishing ability for a winger, making him more than just a player who relies on pace and dribbling. 

* His playmaking is a nice bonus for a LW. Díaz isn't simply a touchline winger who receives the ball and immediately tries to dribble past someone. 

* His smoothness does make him comfortable when changing direction, carrying the ball and performing quick movements in tight areas. 

* The physicality is a particularly useful advantage for a winger.
reviews.cons:
This is his biggest gameplay limitation. A 4-star weak foot is still perfectly usable, but it means Díaz won't be as consistently reliable when forced onto his weaker side. 

* The lack of useful traits is another downside, especially at a high OVR like 125. Traits can give a player additional characteristics that complement their natural strengths.
reviews.verdict: Luis Díaz is a very dangerous LW built around pace, dribbling and direct attacking. His Rapid pace, smooth ball control, good shooting and physicality make him excellent at taking on defenders and creating chances, while his decent playmaking adds some versatility. The 4-star weak foot and lack of traits hold him back from being truly elite, but overall, he's a fast, explosive and reliable winger who should perform very well in a direct attacking setup.

reviews.name: Bastian Schweinsteiger
reviews.pros:
Schweinsteiger has good enough pace to work effectively in midfield. 

* His shooting is reliable when you get him onto his stronger foot. 

* This is one of the biggest strengths of the card. Schweinsteiger is very effective at progressing the ball from midfield. 

* The Lvl 2 Bullet Pass is especially valuable because it makes his driven passes quicker and more effective, allowing him to find teammates through tighter spaces and move the ball rapidly during transitions. 

* For a midfielder with Schweinsteiger's physical profile, being decently smooth is a nice bonus. He isn't going to have the ultra-responsive feel of a lightweight CAM, but he shouldn't feel excessively clunky either. 

* This is what really separates him from more attack-oriented CMs. Schweinsteiger can contribute defensively, win challenges and provide protection in front of the back line. 

* The physical side of the card complements his role extremely well. 

* This is a fantastic work-rate combination for a box-to-box CM. High/high work rates encourages Schweinsteiger to contribute to both, offensive and defensive parts on the pitch simultaneously.
reviews.cons: This is the main drawback. A 4-star weak foot isn't terrible, but for a central midfielder, having only four-star reliability on the weaker foot can occasionally hurt.
reviews.verdict: Schweinsteiger looks like an excellent all-round CM. A very balanced box-to-box CM who should be particularly valuable for players wanting midfielders who can both create and defend.

reviews.name: Giorgio Chiellini
reviews.pros:
Insane defending, marking, standing tackles, sliding tackles and awareness are all top-tier. 

* Very strong physically and wins physical battles consistently. 

* Great pace for a CB, making him reliable against fast attackers. 

* Excellent reactions and positioning, rarely feels out of place defensively. 

* Bruiser Lvl 2 + Anticipate Lvl 1 is a really good defensive playstyle combination. 

* Anticipate makes his standing tackles feel more reliable, while Bruiser makes him a beast in physical battles. 

* Dives Into Tackles trait adds even more aggression to his defending. 

* Long Throw is a useful bonus for building attacks from the back.
reviews.cons:
Not the most agile CB when dealing with very quick, highly technical attackers. 

* Anticipate is only Lvl 1, having it at Lvl 2 would have made him an absolute beast.
reviews.verdict:
Chiellini is an absolute defensive monster. His defending, physical presence, pace and tackling make him incredibly reliable at the back, while Bruiser + Anticipate is one of the best combinations you can ask for in a CB. 

He feels like the type of defender who will bully attackers, win tackles and dominate physical battles all game long. If you're looking for a CB who prioritizes defending above everything else, Chiellini is easily one of the best options.

reviews.name: Barzagli
reviews.pros:
A very reliable centre-back with strong all-round defensive ability. 

* His 6'2 height and good physicality make him solid in both ground and aerial duels. 

* Anticipate playstyle makes his tackling, positioning, and defensive reactions feel much more reliable. 

* Pace is good overall and allows him to recover against most attackers. 

* Marking, interceptions, positioning, and tackling are all very solid. 

* Dives Into Tackles trait adds extra aggression and helps him win difficult challenges. 

* Acrobatic Clearance is useful in dangerous situations, helping him deal with difficult balls and crosses. 

* Passing and overall ball distribution are good enough for comfortable build-up play.
reviews.cons:
Can feel slightly slow at times, especially against very fast attackers. 

* Occasionally feels inconsistent compared to the very best CB options.
reviews.verdict: A strong and dependable CB with excellent positioning, useful defensive traits, and the Anticipate playstyle. Not the fastest or most consistent defender available, but still a high-quality option.

reviews.name: Frank Ribery
reviews.pros:
A complete and explosive winger with almost everything you could want from a LW. 

* 5 star weak foot and 5 star skill moves make him incredibly reliable and creative in every attacking situation. 

* Trickster playstyle makes his skill moves faster and more effective, while Finesse Expert greatly improves his finishing. 

* Pace is excellent, with quick acceleration and dangerous attacking movement. 

* Dribbling and ball control are outstanding, feeling extremely smooth and agile. 

* Finishing and shooting are elite, with excellent accuracy from close, mid, and long range. 

* Passing, crossing, and overall ball distribution are brilliant. 

* 5 star stamina allows him to maintain his performance throughout the match. 

* Can also play as LM and performs brilliantly there.
reviews.cons:
At 5'7, his height is very low and his physicality isn't the strongest, so he can sometimes struggle in physical duels. 

* Extremely expensive as a Box player, making him unrealistic for most regular F2P players.
reviews.verdict: An almost flawless winger with elite pace, dribbling, finishing, creativity, and perfect 5 star Weak foot/Skill move/Stamina. The only real drawback is his cost, but if you can afford him, he's an absolute end-game attacker.

reviews.name: Lucas Torriera
reviews.pros:
Torreira excels at reading the game. His positioning and anticipation allow him to intercept passes consistently and break up opposition attacks before they become dangerous. 

* His standing tackles are clean and reliable, while his aggressive defensive approach helps him win possession frequently. 

* His short passing, long passing, and vision allow him to recycle possession efficiently and launch attacks from deep without unnecessary errors. 

* Torreira is constantly involved in defensive actions throughout the match. His movement and positioning ensure he covers large areas of the pitch, making him an effective ball-winning midfielder.
