* His stamina allows him to maintain a high level of performance for the full 90 minutes, making repeated defensive recoveries while continuing to support the build-up play.
reviews.cons:
Despite his aggression, Torreira's relatively small frame means he can struggle against taller, stronger midfielders and powerful strikers in shoulder-to-shoulder battles. 

* Although Torreira is a dependable holding midfielder, there are several 119-rated CDMs who offer better physicality, aerial ability, or all-round midfield presence.
reviews.verdict: Lucas Torreira is an intelligent and technically gifted defensive midfielder who excels at intercepting passes, winning tackles, and controlling possession from deep. His excellent passing, stamina, and defensive awareness make him a reliable anchor in midfield, particularly for possession-based systems. However, his lack of size and aerial dominance, along with stronger alternatives in the same rating range, prevent him from being among the very best CDMs available.

reviews.name: Frank Lampard
reviews.pros:
Excellent attacking CM who constantly makes dangerous late runs into the box. 

* Clinical long-range shooting and powerful finishing make him a genuine goal threat. 

* Bullet Pass Lv.1 significantly improves driven ground passes with better accuracy and speed. 

* Reliable passer who can control the tempo and distribute the ball effectively. 

* High stamina allows him to perform at a high level throughout the entire match. 

* High/Medium work rate keeps him actively involved in attacks while still contributing defensively. 

* Powerful Driven Free Kick, Long Shot Taker, and Outside Foot Shot traits make him even more dangerous in and around the box. 

* Alternative positions: CAM & CDM, giving him added squad flexibility. 

* One of the best budget beast CMs available for just 17,365 Shards, offering incredible value for the price.
reviews.cons:
Defensively average and not ideal as a lone holding midfielder. 

* Feels a bit stiff while turning under pressure compared to more agile midfielders. 

* Doesn't offer elite defensive presence in midfield.
reviews.verdict: Lampard is an attacking-minded CM who excels at scoring from midfield, making late runs, and controlling possession with quality passing. If paired with a defensively solid midfielder, he'll consistently deliver goals and assists while offering the flexibility to play at CAM or CDM when needed.

reviews.name: Gianluigi Buffon
reviews.pros:
Outstanding shot-stopper with elite diving, reflexes and positioning. 

* 192cm (6'4) height gives him excellent reach against finesse shots and long-range efforts. 

* Very reliable handling, reducing rebounds and second-chance goals. 

* Got deflector that is one of the best GK PlayStyles, improving parries, reducing dangerous rebounds and making saves much more reliable. 

* Consistently makes clutch saves in H2H, especially in one-on-one situations. 

* Fast reactions make him feel very dependable against close-range shots.
reviews.cons:
Lacks the Long Thrower special trait, making quick counter-attacks from distribution less effective. 

* Distribution and kicking are good but not among the very best. 

* Premium Pass player makes him a significant investment.
reviews.verdict: Buffon combines elite reflexes, positioning and reliable handling with his 192cm frame, making him an extremely consistent last line of defense. His PlayStyle also helps reduce dangerous rebounds, adding even more value in competitive matches. If you're looking for a top-end gk, he is a great choice.

reviews.name: Ricardo Carvalho
reviews.pros:
Exceptional defending with elite marking, interceptions and tackling. 

* Anticipate Lv.2 is one of the best defensive playstyles, allowing him to win tackles cleanly and stop attacks before they develop. 

* Guardian Lv.1 makes shoulder challenges and hard tackles very effective. 

* Surprisingly very quick for a CB - easily keeps up with fast attackers. 

* Low/High work rate keeps him defensively solid at all times with excellent positioning and quick reactions. 

* Outstanding defensive positioning and awareness, rarely caught out of place. 

* Strong physical presence while remaining agile and responsive. 

* Excellent ball-winning ability without committing unnecessary fouls. 

* Very reliable in aerial duels despite not being the tallest CB. 

* Comfortable on the ball with solid passing to start attacks from the back. 

* Special traits like Dives Into Tackles, Acrobatic Clearance, and Power Header make him even more reliable in crucial defensive situations.
reviews.cons:
At 183 cm (6'0"), he lacks the height advantage of taller meta CBs against certain aerial threats. 

* Premium Box exclusive, making him difficult for F2P players to obtain.
reviews.verdict: Ricardo Carvalho is an elite centre-back who excels through positioning, anticipation, pace and defensive intelligence rather than just height. His Anticipate Lv.2, Guardian Lv.1, excellent work rates, and elite defensive traits make him one of the safest and most consistent CBs in the game.

reviews.name: Victor Osimhen
reviews.pros:
Elite pace with Rapid PlayStyle makes him devastating on through balls and counter attacks. 

* Clinical Finisher Lv.2 makes regular shots inside the box extremely reliable. 

* Outstanding finishing and shot power - converts chances consistently with either foot. 

* Strong physicality allows him to shield the ball and bully most defenders. 

* Excellent attacking positioning, always making dangerous runs behind the backline. 

* Powerful aerial threat with the Power Header trait, making crosses and corners a real weapon. 

* Surprisingly good ball control for a physical striker and doesn't feel heavy on the ball.
reviews.cons:
Not the most agile striker and isn't built for close-control dribbling. 

* Joystick responsiveness is decent but not elite compared to meta forwards. 

* Bit expensive with a 57,960 Shard cost.
reviews.verdict: Osimhen is a complete out-and-out striker built for scoring goals. His elite pace, physical dominance, Clinical Finisher Lv.2 make him one of the most dangerous finishers in the game. He isn't the best option if your playstyle revolves around intricate dribbling, but if you want a striker who constantly gets in behind, wins aerial duels, and finishes almost everything, he's an outstanding choice.

reviews.name: Reece James
reviews.pros:
Reliable defensively with excellent positioning against tricky wingers. 

* Strong in physical duels and rarely gets bullied near the touchline. 

* Delivers accurate crosses and long passes, making him a genuine attacking outlet. 

* Excellent link-up play with midfielders and wingers thanks to his composure on the ball. 

* A true box-to-box full-back who contributes effectively in both attack and defence.
reviews.cons:
Doesn't feel as explosive as the fastest meta right-backs in one-on-one foot races. 

* His attacking runs can sometimes be a little conservative if you're expecting constant overlaps. 

* Against elite pace merchants, he can occasionally need manual support to avoid being exposed.
reviews.verdict: Reece James is a dependable, complete right-back who rarely puts a foot wrong. He offers the perfect balance between defensive security and attacking support, making him a great fit for players who want consistency instead of flashy moments. He may not be the absolute meta choice, but if you value reliability, physical presence, and quality on the ball, James is a full-back you can trust throughout the match.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Davinson Sanchez
reviews.pros:
His acceleration and sprint speed allow him to recover against fast strikers, making him highly effective against through balls and counterattacks. 

* His positioning is excellent, allowing him to read attacks early and consistently make interceptions. He maintains a solid defensive line and rarely gets caught out of position. 

* His standing and sliding tackles are highly reliable. Sánchez wins possession cleanly and aggressively, making him a dependable defender in one-on-one situations. 

* With impressive strength and aggression, he dominates physical duels against most strikers. He is difficult to outmuscle and performs well when defending inside the penalty area. 

* His height, jumping, and heading make him a strong presence in the air. He clears crosses comfortably, defends set pieces effectively, and is a threat from attacking corners. 

* His passing is composed enough to play out from the back. While not an elite ball-playing defender, he can comfortably start attacks with accurate short and medium-range passes.
reviews.cons: While Sánchez is a very solid defender, several other centre-backs offer superior overall defending, ball-playing ability, or versatility, making them stronger long-term investments if budget isn't a concern.
reviews.verdict: Davinson Sánchez is a dependable and physically dominant centre-back with excellent pace, strong tackling, aerial dominance, and solid defensive awareness. Although there are better centre-back options within the same rating range, Sánchez is still a reliable choice for players seeking a fast and defensively consistent CB.

reviews.name: Petr Cech
reviews.pros:
One of the best goalkeepers in the game with elite all-round performance. 

* His 6'5 height gives him outstanding reach and a commanding presence inside the box. 

* Diving is exceptional, allowing him to make incredible full-stretch saves. 

* Reflexes are top-tier, reacting instantly to close-range shots and rebounds. 

* Positioning is excellent, helping him cover angles and reduce scoring opportunities. 

* Handling is very reliable, with very few rebounds or unnecessary spills. 

* Kicking and overall ball distribution are excellent, making build-up play much easier. 

* Deflector playstyle is extremely useful, pushing dangerous shots into safe areas instead of back into play. 

* Long Thrower trait helps launch quick and accurate counterattacks. 

* Very consistent and dependable in every game mode.
reviews.cons: No noticeable weaknesses.
reviews.verdict: A complete and dominant goalkeeper with elite diving, reflexes, positioning, and distribution. With Deflector, Long Thrower, and his incredible consistency, he's one of the very best goalkeepers in FC Mobile.

reviews.name: Didier Drogba
reviews.pros:
A powerful and dominant striker with elite physical presence. 

* Bruiser playstyle helps him shield the ball brilliantly and overpower defenders in physical duels. 

* Precision Header playstyle, combined with the Power Header trait, makes him one of the best aerial threats in the game. 

* Finishing is excellent from close and mid-range, and he's reliable with both feet in those situations. 

* Passing and positioning are very good, helping him link up play and make dangerous attacking runs. 

* Long Shot Taker trait improves his shooting from distance with his strong foot. 

* Outstanding in aerial situations, making him a constant threat from crosses and set pieces.
reviews.cons:
Doesn't feel very smooth on the ball, and his dribbling can feel heavy. 

* Pace is decent, but he doesn't feel as fast as other elite strikers. 

* 4 star weak foot is a slight downside, especially for long-range shots and power shots on his weaker foot.
reviews.verdict: A dominant target man with elite strength, heading, and clinical finishing inside the box. While he lacks agility and explosive pace, he's one of the best options for players who prefer a physical striker.

reviews.name: Ilkay Gundogan
reviews.pros:
Elite passing ability that unlocks defenses with ease. 

* Exceptional positioning and movement, always offering a passing option. 

* Times his attacking runs brilliantly and contributes consistently in the final third. 

* Feels calm under pressure, making midfield play effortless. 

* Perfect for possession-based and tiki-taka style gameplay.
reviews.cons:
Can struggle in physical battles against stronger, box-to-box midfielders. 

* Defensive contribution is decent but not reliable enough to be your primary ball-winner. 

* Doesn't have the explosive burst that meta CMs use to dominate end-to-end transitions. 

* His impact depends on your playstyle, players who prefer fast, direct football may find him underwhelming.
reviews.verdict: Gündoğan is all about brains over brawn. He's a midfielder who makes the game look easy with intelligent movement, crisp passing, and composed ball control. If you enjoy controlling possession and building attacks patiently, he'll be a joy to use. However, if you're looking for a powerhouse who can win every duel and cover the entire pitch on his own, there are better meta options. A classy midfielder with elite football IQ, but not the complete all-round machine many players look for.
reviews.author: Lonewolf

reviews.name: Baris Alper Yilmaz
reviews.pros:
Yılmaz possesses excellent acceleration and sprint speed, making him a constant threat down the left flank. He can easily outpace full-backs, stretch defenses, and lead dangerous counterattacks. 

* One of his standout qualities is his responsiveness on the ball. His close control, agility, and balance allow him to glide past defenders with ease, making him highly effective in one-on-one situations and tight spaces. 

* Yılmaz is an excellent creator from wide areas. His vision, short passing, and crossing enable him to consistently provide quality service into the box, whether through early crosses or cutbacks. 

* Despite playing as a left midfielder, he is capable of contributing goals regularly. His finishing inside the box, finesse shots, and long-range efforts make him a genuine secondary scoring option. 

* Yılmaz can maintain his work rate throughout the match, making repeated attacking runs while still tracking back to support the defense when required.
reviews.cons:
Yılmaz isn't particularly strong and can struggle against powerful full-backs in shoulder-to-shoulder duels. He performs best when relying on agility rather than physical battles. 

* While he tracks back thanks to his stamina, his tackling and defensive awareness are only average. He is better suited to attacking responsibilities than defensive duties.
reviews.verdict: Yılmaz is an excellent left midfielder who combines pace, dribbling, creativity, and reliable finishing into a well-rounded attacking package. His ability to beat defenders, create chances, and contribute goals makes him a dangerous option for any team. Although his physicality and aerial ability aren't standout attributes, his technical quality and attacking impact more than compensate.
